description:
About The Opportunity

As a Mid-Market Account Executive - BNL (f/m/d), you’ll drive Contentful’s growth by leading the end-to-end sales process with our top-tier clients. You’ll be instrumental in driving adoption and engagement, finding new revenue opportunities, and creating customer enablement initiatives within a few named accounts.  You’ll work closely with our partnership and customer success team to lead a consultative sales process by speaking to professional developers and business leaders in the BNL markets.

This role will require you to be in our Central London office 2 or 3 times a week.

What To Expect?

  • Self-generation of the pipeline through outbound motions in conjunction with marketing and BDR teams to help create new opportunities in regional accounts
  • Drive expansion opportunities with existing clients in the BNL territory.
  • Grow existing accounts by leveraging relationships and following our comprehensive “land and expand” sales model
  • Meet quarterly and annual sales goals by developing an account strategy and pipeline, managing internal and client processes, maintaining sales reports, developing market and competitor knowledge, delivering presentations to customers, and creating sales proposals
  • Manage RFI/RFQ requests with Contentful internal and customer teams
  • Refine and evolve our "land-and-expand" model in collaboration with Sales, Partnerships, and Customer Success teams
  • Seek to understand the digital experience challenges of prospects and clients while aligning the ROI of Contentful with those challenges to ensure a value-based selling approach
  • Work closely with Sales Engineers and Solution Architects to uncover technical challenges and opportunities
  • Develop innovative proposals, position complex pricing structures, and negotiate contracts and deal-closing requirements quickly and efficiently
  • Work closely with customer success & marketing teams to ensure that best practices of Contentful are shared and implemented at the respective customer

What Do You Need To Be Successful?

  • 3+ years of experience selling a technical platform working as a Sales Development Representative (SDR), Business Development Representative (BDR), and/or Account Executive
  • 1+ years of individual quota-carrying experience
  • 1+ years of growing and expanding existing customer accounts 
  • Demonstrated expertise in closing $60-100k+ opportunities
  • Ability to drive your own pipeline generation with outbound capabilities

 Nice To Have:

  • Experience working with Partner ecosystems to work with customers.
  • Understanding and experience working in product-led growth sales motions
  • Fluent Dutch language skills

More details about our company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.salesforcebenefits.com.

Contentful is now officially part of Salesforce.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

If you need reasonable accommodations at any point during the application or interview process, please let your Recruiter know.

We are a certified B Corporation, upholding the belief that businesses should have a positive impact on society.

✨ Our values

Our values guide our approach to work and are at the heart of our recruitment process. To join our team, we look for individuals who value:

  • Excellence: We think that every detail counts, and we place great importance on the quality of our deliverables.

  • Trust: We are passionate, committed, and free to act with autonomy.

  • Happiness at work: We enjoy looking on the bright side and we share our enthusiasm with our colleagues and clients.

🤝 The team

You will join our Enterprise Customer Success team for the EMEA, APAC, and NA regions, a group of Customer Success Managers, each responsible for a focused portfolio of our largest and most strategic accounts.

You will join a team of 6, including 5 CSMs and Majhon, Head of Customer Success Enterprise, who will support you in achieving your goals. You will also be part of a global Customer Success community across our five offices.

Here is what the Go-To-Market organization looks like at UpSlide:

  • Account Executives: Prospect, acquire new business acquisition and expand existing accounts

  • Consultants: Lead implementation projects, deliver client training, and ensure successful deployment

  • Customer Success Managers: Own a portfolio of accounts end-to-end, driving retention, renewal signing, expansion within existing entities, value realization, and long-term account growth

  • Support Engineers: Resolve day-to-day technical questions and issues, and ensure a smooth customer experience

🖋️ Your responsibilities

As an Enterprise Customer Success Manager, you will own the end-to-end relationship with a portfolio of our largest, most strategic accounts. You will build deep, multi-threaded relationships with key stakeholders, lead high-impact business reviews, and act as a trusted advisor, proactively protecting and growing revenue across your book through both retention and expansion.

This is a role for someone who thrives on depth: fewer accounts, higher stakes, and the ability to build genuine, senior-level relationships that compound into long-term growth, while knowing how to sync with regional counterparts on accounts that span multiple geographies, keeping a global view of the relationship without owning every part of it directly.

Account Ownership & Revenue Growth (50%)

Own the business performance, strategy, and health of your portfolio of strategic accounts:

  • Take full ownership of your portfolio (ARR, NRR, renewal, risk level)

  • Build and execute structured, tailored account plans for 100% of your accounts, with clear growth and retention objectives

  • Proactively identify both expansion opportunities and churn risk through data analysis and direct relationship insight, and own them through to resolution or close

  • Monitor account health through usage data, adoption metrics, contact network and mapping, and stakeholder engagement

  • Maintain accurate forecasting (renewals, churn, upsell potential) and rigorous CRM discipline (Salesforce accuracy and completeness)

Customer Value & Expertise (40%)

Drive measurable value and position UpSlide as a strategic partner:

  • Lead high-impact Business Reviews focused on ROI and value realization

  • Lead complex or sensitive conversations (renegotiation, escalations, dissatisfaction) with confidence and clarity

  • Secure executive sponsors and build multi-threaded relationships within each account

  • Develop and maintain strong product expertise and a deep understanding of client industries and use cases

  • Craft value-driven narratives tailored to each stakeholder's priorities

Cross-functional Collaboration (10%)

Align with internal teams to maximize customer outcomes and business impact:

  • Partner with Sales on the account expansion strategy and account mapping

  • Collaborate with Professional Services when deeper deployment or training support is needed

  • Work closely with Product and Support to relay structured feedback and improve the customer experience

  • Coordinate with CSMs in other regions on shared or global accounts

  • Contribute to Customer Success best practices and performance improvement initiatives

To work on these tasks, you will mainly use the following tools: Microsoft Office, UpSlide, Salesforce, Gong, PowerBI, and Notion (or local equivalents).

⚡Your goals

You will be assessed on:

  • Net Revenue Retention (NRR)

  • Churn

  • Expansion / upsell contribution

  • Depth and health of executive relationships across your portfolio

  • Ability to maintain full ownership and visibility on shared accounts


You are a great fit if you have:

  • 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a related client-facing/revenue role, including managing enterprise or large, multi-entity accounts in a B2B environment

  • Proven experience managing renewals and churn on strategic / enterprise accounts, with meaningful revenue responsibility

  • A proven track record of generating expansion (upsell/cross-sell) within an enterprise account base

  • Experience in autonomously managing a portfolio of large or multi-entity accounts with significant revenue responsibility

  • Confidence leading executive-level conversations, including complex or difficult ones (renegotiation, dissatisfaction, escalations)

  • Advanced negotiation skills

  • A structured, strategic approach to account planning (objectives, stakeholders, action plans)

  • A value- and ROI-oriented mindset, able to build and defend a business case with senior stakeholders

  • Operational rigor: accurate CRM data, reliable follow-up, dependable forecasting

  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English and French

  • Comfortable working in an international environment, engaging with senior and executive stakeholders

We’d love it if you have:

  • Experience with a CRM / Customer Success platform (Salesforce, Planhat, or equivalent) and analytics / BI tools (PowerBI or equivalent)

  • Knowledge of the financial services/consulting sector

  • Experience managing group or multi-entity account structures

  • Familiarity with SaaS metrics (ARR, NRR, churn, forecasting) and reporting to leadership

  • Fluency in another language (e.g. German)

✨ If you don’t tick all the boxes but you think you’d be a great fit, please apply and tell us why.

Recruitment process

  1. Screening call with Talent Acquisition: A conversation to walk through your experience, motivation, and fit for the role.

  2. Interview with your future manager and a team-meet: A deeper dive into your Customer Success experience and approach to account management. This also includes a live exercise reflecting real challenges of the role, followed by a conversation with members of the wider team.

  3. Final conversation with leadership: A closing discussion to align on ambition, expectations, and next steps.

🚀 We'll conduct a reference check to learn how to help you thrive. On average, our process lasts 3 weeks.

What we offer

🌍 International environment: Start-up with five offices (Paris, London, Berlin, New York, Singapore) and users in more than 60 countries

🌱 Training & professional development: Collaboration with our sister company, IPH, which provides UpSliders with training on key soft skills and management

🎉 Company events: Office socials and international company events (e.g. annual company seminar, team seminar, and sustainability actions taken throughout the year)

🏠 Beautiful office: Office near Opéra (1er arrondissement) – a vibrant space with beautiful common areas and meeting rooms, a nap room, bike storage and showers, tea/coffee, etc.

💻 Hybrid work: A policy adapted to each team’s rhythm

🧑‍💻 Work-from-home budget: €500 WFH equipment budget

💆‍♀️ Wellness package: 50€ per month for physical and mental wellness activities

👶 Family support:

  • Paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents

  • 4 days fully paid leave for sick children up to 6 years old or up to €1,800 for childcare reimbursement

  • Flexible return to work options

  • An additional 5 days are fully paid within 6 months after becoming a parent

✈️ Holidays: 25 vacation days and 9 RTT (with one taken for Solidarity Day)

✅ General:

  • Meal vouchers (Tickets resto): €11 per day on your Swile card (210 tickets per year)

  • Healthcare insurance (Mutuelle): Covered by Alan. You can extend cover to your partner and children

  • Commute (Transports): Metro, RER, bike, or e-scooter - These options are reimbursed 50% by UpSlide

As a B Corp-certified company, we have strong commitments toward our employees, community, clients, suppliers, and the environment. We strive to create an environment where everyone feels welcome. This commitment to diversity and inclusion is applied in our recruitment process and your employee experience once you’ve joined UpSlide ✨

  • Predicting what isn't published. Many private companies publish little or no financial detail.   • Quality that holds while everything underneath moves. We're provider-agnostic. Model choices follow the evals, and we switch LLMs when the numbers say so. That only works if the evals are trusted.

What will you do?

The work is roughly half LLM agents and half custom ML, leaning slightly toward agents.

  • The design of our agent pipelines: architecture, tools, and which model for which task. You'll shape the technical direction with our AI Lead.

  • The evaluation behind agents and models: offline reference sets, live production evals, and the call on whether an improvement is real.

raw.description:
About us

Salience Labs is developing optical circuit switching technology for AI infrastructure, aimed at reducing latency and cost in data centre networks. As we move towards deployment, you'll have real ownership of your area and work alongside a highly technical team on a hard problem in AI infrastructure.

The role

You'll join a multi-disciplinary research team in the UK to lead the development of III-V active components for integration with silicon photonics. You will take devices from epitaxial stack and device design through fabrication with external partners, to characterisation, reliability and qualification.

What you'll be doing

  • Lead the design and modelling of III-V active devices, including epitaxial layer structure, gain and power modelling, optical mode design, and electrical and thermal design

  • Own the technology roadmap and device specifications for your area, translating system requirements into device design and integration targets

  • Lead mask design and tape-outs, including GDS layouts, test structures and design-of-experiment splits

  • Manage fabrication runs with external epitaxy and foundry partners: define process flows, review process and in-line data, and resolve yield issues as the technology scales

  • Define and lead the characterisation strategy at wafer, chip and integrated-PIC level, including building and automating test setups

  • Analyse test data, correlate measured performance with design and process variations, and drive design iterations to close performance gaps

  • Work with packaging and reliability engineers on burn-in, accelerated ageing, failure analysis and qualification

  • Mentor engineers and, as the team grows, help recruit and develop new team members

Essential requirements

  • PhD in physics, photonics, electrical engineering, optical engineering or a related subject with 6+ years' relevant experience, or a Master's degree with 8+ years' relevant experience, including at least 4 years' hands-on development of III-V optical amplifiers or semiconductor lasers, preferably in industry

  • Proven track record of taking III-V devices from concept through design, fabrication and test, ideally including qualification

  • Deep understanding of semiconductor laser and amplifier physics: optical gain, carrier dynamics, quantum-well design, noise, gain saturation and nonlinearities, thermal effects and polarisation dependence

  • Hands-on knowledge of III-V epitaxy and fabrication processes (e.g. MOCVD/MBE growth, lithography, etching, passivation, metallisation, facet/AR coating), and experience working with external foundries

  • Experience characterising amplifiers or lasers, including optical spectrum analysis, gain and noise measurement, wafer-level probing, temperature-controlled testing and test automation

  • Experience with simulation and layout tools for photonic devices, such as Lumerical, Photon Design, Crosslight, RSoft, COMSOL, KLayout, L-Edit or Cadence Virtuoso

  • Proven ability to lead technical projects across design, process, test and packaging functions, and experience mentoring or supervising engineers

  • Excellent communication skills, critical thinking, attention to detail and self-motivation

Nice to have

  • Experience integrating III-V active devices with silicon photonics, including coupling design between III-V and silicon waveguides

  • Experience line-managing a technical team

  • Experience with reliability testing and failure analysis of III-V devices

  • Experience developing PDK building blocks or compact models for active devices

  • Programming experience (Python, MATLAB or C++) for simulation, test automation and data analysis

  • Knowledge of photonic packaging, including fibre coupling, thermal design and TEC control

  • A track record of high-quality patents and research papers

raw.title: Head of Platform (Infrastructure & DevOps)
raw.description:
What we are building

Mimica is an AI-powered process intelligence platform enabling enterprises and individuals to reclaim their most precious resource: time. We've all seen repetitive tasks and redundant processes quietly drain productivity and creativity. Not because companies don’t want to become more efficient, but because they don’t know where to start.

Mimica automatically analyzes your team’s work, then generates the AI agents to execute it. Our software turns everyday work into data-backed decisions, helping companies remove process bottlenecks, automate the right tasks, and upskill teams with precision and confidence.

We’ve raised $26 million in Series B financing and are scaling fast. Backed by investors including Khosla Ventures and Paladin Capital, our proprietary AI technology is trusted by Fortune 500 companies to accelerate transformation. Mimica is recognized as a Top 100 AI Start-up by Accel and an industry Leader by the Everest Group.

Our team

Behind our platform is a team of exceptionally talented people, remote-first and globally distributed across 16+ countries. We're looking for curious, collaborative people excited to solve complex problems. You'll join a fast-paced environment built on high ownership, bottom-up thinking, and transparent, open communication – helping some of the world's leading organizations transform the way work gets done with AI.

Your mission

Mimica is growing fast, and so is the demand on our Platform Team. As Head of Platform, you will lead a lean but highly capable team that is the backbone of every engineering squad in the company, and you will own the infrastructure strategy, including all AI infrastructure, as we scale.

The Platform team services the entire engineering organisation: keeping environments healthy, unblocking teams, building the infrastructure that lets everyone else move faster, and working with teams regarding SRE topics and developer experience too. As you work with us, the role will develop into designing Mimica’s infrastructure strategy at scale. The team has 4 engineers today, around 6 by the end of the year, and 10+ in 2027, so the role has the potential to grow into a “manager of managers” level as the company grows.

This is a role with real scope: expanding to multi-region and physically separated database environments, supporting Mimica’s first installable infrastructure component for enterprise, and owning FinOps. One day you are defining the standard menu of deployment options for enterprise customers, the next you are in a security review or an architecture decision on AI infrastructure.

We are looking for leaders with either an application development or a systems/infrastructure background.

What matters more than your origin story is your hands-on credibility with Kubernetes, IaC, and cloud platforms, your ability to lead engineers and other leaders, and your ability to collaborate closely with Product, ML, Security, Sales and Customer Success. If you want to work in a place where your contributions are visible, your scope is broad, and the problems are real, this is the role for you.

Part of your day-to-day

  • Own Mimica's infrastructure strategy and the platform roadmap across all products, with the final call on cloud architecture, deployment models, infra vendors and platform standards.

  • Lead and grow the Platform team: Manage existing Platform and SREs, plan headcount, set goals and metrics, and design the sub-team split (Cloud & Developer Platform, Reliability & SRE, AI Infrastructure) as the team grows.

  • Own all AI infrastructure, including training and serving infra, MLOps tooling, Vertex and model access.

  • Maintain Mimica’s DevEx culture - improve agency for product teams without compromising on compliance, create paved roads for deployments, and identify pain points as they arise.

  • Own the infra and LLM budget, forecast and unit economics, including cost attribution by product and customer and the GCP relationship.

  • Own reliability across engineering: SLOs, on-call model, incident process, postmortems, DR testing and capacity planning.

  • Own the CI/CD and developer platform, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, ArgoCD, Crossplane) and observability standards (Honeycomb, Grafana, Loki).

  • Work with the Platform PM, your peer, to define client needs and turn them into the platform roadmap.

  • Act as the named technical owner for infrastructure in enterprise deals and security reviews, joining high-stakes sales and client calls and coaching your team to take the rest.

  • Guide the craft mentors for infrastructure, MLOps and Python engineering, and set engineering-wide standards for reliability, on-call, CI/CD and craft.

  • Report monthly platform health and costs to leadership, and lead the infrastructure part of technical due diligence.

Requirements

  • Proven experience leading engineers, ideally including managing a team lead or other managers, and growing a team through hiring and sub-team design.

  • Solid hands-on experience with Kubernetes, whether on GKE (preferred), EKS, OnPrem, or another managed Kubernetes service, across multiple regions.

  • Proven experience with infrastructure-as-code as a core part of your platform, such as Terraform, and with ArgoCD or a comparable GitOps tool.

  • A track record in owning reliability: setting SLOs and SLAs, running on-call, leading incident response and postmortems, and testing disaster recovery.

  • Observability experience with at least one major platform: Honeycomb, Datadog, Grafana, or New Relic.

  • Comfortable with code, and able to review architecture and prototypes hands-on.

  • Experience owning an infrastructure budget, including cloud cost attribution, forecasting and cloud-provider relationships.

  • Experience designing deployment models for enterprise customers (single tenant, regional, data residency) and supporting security reviews and contracted SLAs.

  • Background in startups or scale-ups: you are used to ambiguity, moving fast, and wearing multiple hats.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills: you can translate infrastructure complexity into clear language for engineers, executives and clients, and you know when to say no to bespoke requests.

Bonus / Nice to have

  • Familiarity with Crossplane, or a similar product like Config Connector.

  • Experience with Temporal for workflow orchestration.

  • Security and compliance experience, particularly supporting SOC 2.

  • Experience supporting a funding round, including technical due diligence.

💰 Generous compensation + stock options - aligned with our internal framework, market data, and individual skills.

🏢 Distributed work: Work from anywhere - fully remote, in our hubs, or a mix.

💻 Company-issued laptop, remote setup stipend, and co-working budget

☀️ Ample paid time off, in addition to local public holidays

🍼 Enhanced parental leave

🧘‍♀️ Health & retirement benefits

📖 Annual learning & development budget

🌴 Annual workaways and regular virtual & in-person socials

🌍 Opportunity to contribute to groundbreaking projects that shape the future of work

We match owners with serious buyers, from search funds to private equity, and handle the whole process in one place, including financial due diligence and acquisition finance. Own the target lists and the logic behind them, and keep sharpening them on what actually predicts a seller and a strong business. Convert interest. Write and send the outreach yourself, follow up with owners who respond, and book them in with a Transaction Manager. Find what works. Run several experiments at once, back what produces meetings and drop what doesn't. Letters, events and ideas of your own can all earn a place. Make manda credible. Owners look us up before they reply. Help make sure what they find, from our website to LinkedIn, gives them a reason to get in touch. Your messages are short, clear and human, the kind a busy owner actually answers, and you're just as at ease on the phone with someone who has spent thirty years building their business. You follow through. A reply that never becomes a meeting is a lead lost. You're honest about results. You'd rather report a bad week than dress it up. You're AI-savvy. The requirements Essential: Some experience in outreach, sales or growth, whether in an SDR or BDR role, marketing, a startup or a project of your own. Evidence of initiative matters more than a polished CV. Numerate and analytical. Working out who to contact is as much of this job as contacting them. Comfortable with rejection. Most owners won't reply, and plenty who do won't be ready yet. A genuine interest in SMEs, M&A or how businesses change hands. Based in London and available full-time. Bonus: Hands-on with outbound tools such as HubSpot or LinkedIn Sales Navigator. You've worked to a meetings or pipeline target, and hit it. Experience building a targeting or lead-scoring model. Please include your salary expectations with your application. The culture At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time. A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years. Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support. 3% Pension contributions on total earnings. Your own journey is important to us too. Choosing a role here means joining a network of innovators from all walks of life; a group of passionate individuals who consistently deliver. Here, you’ll find the tools you need to build the career you want. Whether you’re taking the direct route or trying a new path, we’ll support you no matter what.

The Role_

This is a senior role for someone who combines deep technical expertise with strong judgement and the ability to operate across teams. You’ll help shape the technical direction of Masabi’s platform while staying close enough to the detail to design, review and deliver meaningful technical work.

Working across the engineering organisation, you’ll act as a senior technical leader: defining and evolving architecture, guiding complex decisions, and contributing hands-on where it matters most. A particular focus for this role is strengthening our data architecture, how we structure, use and build on the data our platform generates.

The role suits someone who can move between system-level thinking and implementation, someone who understands trade-offs, can navigate ambiguity, and helps turn complex or loosely defined problems into clear, practical technical approaches.

Location_

// This role is available in a fully remote model for candidates based in Romania


Responsibilities_

  • Shape Masabi’s platform architecture, including platform blueprint definition, standards and best practices

  • Help shape Masabi's data architecture and strategy, including how we structure, store and make use of the data generated across our platform

  • Design and deliver scalable, robust, cost efficient services aligned with platform blueprint

  • Stay hands-on in code and technical delivery, including reviews and targeted contributions

  • Identify and work through complex platform challenges related to scalability, performance, resilience and cost

  • Act as a senior technical advisor across engineering teams, supporting and influencing technical decisions and ensuring Masabi standards are followed

  • Shape and contribute to technical roadmap planning and prioritisation of platform improvements

  • Support RFP estimation and technical scoping for complex initiatives

  • Produce clear, high-quality technical documentation and architecture artefacts

  • Improve how architecture is understood and applied across engineering and the wider business

  • Contribute to and help shape technical forums and working groups, including areas such as API and architecture governance


About You_

  • You bring strong experience designing and evolving distributed systems and microservices architectures

  • You’ve operated at Principal or Staff level, shaping technical direction across multiple teams or domains

  • You are comfortable staying hands-on, contributing in code, design and delivery when needed

  • You have strong experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and modern infrastructure practices

  • You’ve worked on systems where scale, reliability, performance and cost trade-offs matter, and can navigate those decisions thoughtfully

  • You have proven experience in data architecture (e.g. data platforms, pipelines, warehousing or data lakes) and working on products built on top of large data stores

  • You can take loosely defined (early stage) business or technical problems and turn them into clear, actionable technical approaches

  • You communicate complex ideas clearly and effectively, and produce structured documentation that helps both technical and non-technical audiences make decisions

  • You’ve contributed to engineering standards, architecture patterns or platform direction

  • Strong experience with REST API design in complex, multi-service environments, ideally including how APIs are consumed on the front end

  • Interest in or exposure to AI-enabled systems, particularly understanding architectural implications in production

Nice To Have_

  • Experience breaking monolithic applications into microservices architectures

  • Experience with event-driven architectures (e.g. Kafka, schema governance)

  • Experience improving cloud cost and system efficiency at scale

  • Familiarity with a range of tools and technologies including:

    • Development: Kotlin, Java

    • Data storage/processing: DynamoDB, MySQL, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark

    • Infrastructure as code and CI/CD: Terraform, GitLab CI/CD

// You don’t need to have experience in every area listed above. If you bring strong fundamentals, good judgement and a willingness to learn, we’d still love to hear from you.

Some of Our Benefits_

  • 25 days holiday per year plus the Christmas Shutdown (another 3-4 days)

  • Premium medical care via Regina Maria

  • Mental health support

  • Menopause support

  • Regular social gatherings with a monthly allowance for each employee

  • Up to €1000 training budget per year

  • €200 to spend on your home office

  • Choice of workstation

  • Ability to work for up to 3 months per year from any country in the world

Careers at Masabi are for people going places - driven by a mission to make transit fair and accessible for all.

// We are a network of innovators from all walks of life, passionate about making a difference. At Masabi, we operate with openness and trust, creating an environment where everyone feels empowered to bring their whole, authentic selves to work.

Whoever you are, just be yourself.
// We welcome applications from underrepresented groups, including disabled and neurodivergent people, and can make adjustments at any stage of the process. You’re also welcome to share your pronouns whenever you feel comfortable. Together, we simplify journeys, remove barriers, and improve daily life for millions.

Why Join Masabi?

  • Driven by Purpose – We believe in journeys made simple. The work isn’t always easy, but the best things never are.

  • Encouraged to Accelerate – Masabi is going places and our people are in the driving seat. Whether you’re taking the direct route or exploring new paths, we support your journey.

  • Advancing with Empathy – We put people first and foster a culture of learning, not blame. No matter your cargo, we share the load.

We’re already powering journeys - are you ready to join us?

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Develop and maintain Python-based API integrations between our HR information system (HRIS) and business systems, including finance, travel, expense management, and recruiting platforms.
  • Build and maintain cloud-native services, web applications, and containerized workloads on Microsoft Azure.
  • Implement automation for system workflows, onboarding/offboarding, access-related processes, and data synchronization.
  • Create and maintain deployment pipelines and Infrastructure-as-Code with Terraform.
  • Own integrations through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support; respond to alerts and troubleshoot issues across APIs, Azure services, and data sources within agreed SLAs.
  • Implement safeguards for sensitive employee data, including validation, audit trails, and controls around mass changes.
  • Work with business stakeholders to clarify requirements and maintain technical documentation as part of each change.

We expect you to have:

  • 3+ years of integration or backend development experience, including hands-on experience deploying and supporting production workloads in Microsoft Azure.
  • Practical experience with Azure compute and integration services. Our stack includes Azure Functions, App Service, Container Apps, Container Instances, Service Bus, and API Management.
  • Practical Python development skills, including maintaining and debugging existing services and automations.
  • Experience integrating REST APIs, webhooks, and Microsoft Graph API, with an understanding of pagination, rate limits, retries, and idempotency.
  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and Terraform for Azure deployments.
  • Good understanding of OAuth 2.0, Microsoft Entra ID, and managed identities for secure authentication and service-to-service access.
  • Experience designing and working with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MSSQL, etc.).
  • Experience with automated testing and diagnosing production issues through logs, monitoring, and alerts.

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Experience integrating HRIS or other business systems, such as ERP, expense management, or recruiting platforms.
  • Azure certifications (AZ-204, AZ-900, AZ-104).
  • Hands-on experience with Application Insights and Log Analytics.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools, with the ability to critically evaluate their output.

#LI-RK1

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

title: Manager, Software Engineering, Operations
description: Want to lead engineers building software that helps pros get the job done and know exactly how their business is doing? Then Jobber might be the place for you! We’re looking for a Manager, Software Engineering to be part of our SP (Service Provider) Operations group, focused on helping Service Providers run their day-to-day operations efficiently and effectively. Jobber exists to help people in small businesses be successful. We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers, while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn’t like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That’s why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want! Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail’s Canada’s Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada’s Technology Fast 50™, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500™ lists. With an Executive team that has over thirty years of industry experience of leading the way, we’ve come a long way from our first customer in 2011—but we’ve just scratched the surface of what we want to accomplish for our customers . We help employees grow professionally; we have a ton of onboarding resources, tutorials, hackathons and buddies to support learnings and provide opportunities to innovate. We have a range of experience levels on teams which allows for mentor/mentee opportunities. Leaders at Jobber work with empathy and support employees to build healthy work-life harmony. Bring your dedication and passion to this job to fulfill your goals. The team: In this role, you will manage the engineering teams behind one of Jobber's most important domains, Jobs Teams, as part of the greater SP Operations Group. The Jobs Team is at the heart of how service businesses operate, and we are constantly improving how service providers orchestrate work from start to finish so they can confidently deliver every job with quality. You will work alongside peers from Product Management, Design, and the rest of the Engineering Leadership team to ensure the tools we build help small businesses run more efficiently and grow with confidence! The role: As a leader within the SP Operations group, you will manage the engineering teams to deliver high quality, on time while they get to grow and learn along the way. The SP Operations group's mission is to help Service Providers run their businesses as efficiently as possible. We build the tools that help with day-to-day operations, from scheduling and managing work and crew to ensure every job gets done, to giving business owners the visibility they need to understand their business health and make informed decisions. Reporting to a Senior Manager of Software Engineering, the Manager of Software Engineering will lead and support their team members in developing their skills and advancing their careers—all while contributing to our mission of empowering small businesses. You'll also play a key role in shaping the technical direction of our platform, ensuring it remains reliable and high-performing as we scale Jobber. The Manager, Software Engineering will: Live and breathe performance facilitation. You want to work with your team(s) to help them master their individual crafts, while also collaborating to build extraordinary experiences and systems. Be committed to the success of your people. You will help them set goals, have regular 1-on-1s, and provide constructive feedback and coaching to ensure your team's success. You’ll work to understand employees’ career direction and work to empower their journey by acting as a mentor and coach. Develop a world-class team alongside a world-class organization. You’ll participate in recruiting events and the hiring process while also working to level up your internal team while implementing new processes, all to develop a world-class engineering department. Remove roadblocks and build guardrails. You’ll work with the other leaders to create and maintain an environment where people can rapidly produce top-quality work that ultimately helps our customers be successful. Collaborate with other stakeholders across the business. Whether it’s our Management teams within Product, or our Business Technology teams, you’re working closely with other Jobberinos to find the best solutions in Jobber for small businesses. To be successful, you should have: A track record of success in being an established software engineer, as well as time spent in a leadership position, guiding a team in the delivery of quality software. Strong full-stack technical background, including design and architectural experience. A drive to succeed and deliver impactful projects on time. For a high performing team with a solid roadmap that might look like getting out of their way, but for a team whose delivery is in doubt, it means getting in and getting dirty, and working with the team to find a path back to success. The ability to be agile in an agile environment. You’ll need to be able to lead and teach your team to adapt to change, while also thinking critically and creatively to find answers to problems. Effective written and oral communication. Being transparent with your team and establishing an open dialogue will be a key to success in supporting your coaching conversations and discussions. To be a leader and mentor. You’ll bring your shared experience into conversations to influence and provide constructive feedback to direct reports throughout the journey to ensure goals are being met and exceeded. Familiarity or comfort in AI tools and AI augmented development rhythms. Highly desired, but not a dealbreaker: Previous experience with our development stack: ReactJS, Typescript, Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, and GraphQL. Previous experience with building zero to one projects from initial discovery and design, through implementation, and into delivery and measurement. Location: We believe great collaboration is intentional, and sometimes that means coming together in person to build, brainstorm, and connect. To support this, the role is open to candidates based in one of our hub cities: Edmonton, Toronto, Vancouver, or Kitchener-Waterloo. Compensation: At Jobber, we also believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and supportive of your experience and growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $169,200 CAD, a midpoint of $199,100 CAD , and a maximum salary of $228,900 CAD, designed to reflect the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling. We design our compensation to reflect each new hire's skills, experience, and the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long-term impact, with fully established hires typically starting around the midpoint. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions, while offers below the midpoint reflect strong potential with room to develop. This approach ensures that compensation aligns with both an individual's current capabilities and their opportunity for future growth. Base salary is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. Your professional growth matters to us too! You'll have access to a dedicated talent development program that includes career coaching and opportunities for career development. We believe in transparency and open conversations about compensation. If you have any questions about our approach, we're happy to discuss them throughout the hiring process! What you can expect from Jobber: A total compensation package that includes an extended health benefits package with fully paid premiums for both body and mind, matching in RRSP, TFSA or FHSA, and stock options. A dedicated Talent Development team and access to coaching, learning, and leadership programs to help you grow your career, reach your goals, and unlock your full potential. A unique opportunity to build, grow, and leave your impact on a $400-billion industry that has no dominant player...yet. To work with a group of people who are humble, supportive, and give a sh*t about our customers. We believe that diverse teams perform better and that fostering an inclusive work environment is a key part of growing a successful team. We welcome people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to working with applicants requesting accommodation at any stage of the hiring process. A bit more about us: Job by job, we’re transforming the way service is delivered. Your lawn care provider, home cleaning service, plumber or painter could use Jobber to better connect with their customers, save time in the office, invoice faster, and get paid! We’re bringing tens of thousands of people together with technology to deliver billions of dollars a year in services to happy customers. Jobber exists to help make these small businesses successful, and when they’re successful we all win!

title: Software Engineer - Secure Container Images
description: With more than 10 billion pulls , Canonical 's container images are trusted by developers worldwide to build and run software securely and at scale. That trust rests on our commitment to hardened, production-ready images. We are advancing the state of the art with a new generation of Ubuntu-based container images we call "rocks": minimal images engineered for performance and usability and backed by long-term security commitments. As a member of the team, you will own the path from upstream source to published image, turning open source software into tested, signed, and continuously maintained artifacts that developers can deploy with confidence. This is fast-paced, multi-disciplinary software engineering. Because most of the software we package originates from third-party upstreams, you will work across a broad range of container technologies and hundreds of open source projects, often in several programming languages, integrating and maintaining them so they are easy to consume on Ubuntu. raw.jobDescription:
With more than 10 billion pulls, Canonical's container images are trusted by developers worldwide to build and run software securely and at scale. That trust rests on our commitment to hardened, production-ready images.

We are advancing the state of the art with a new generation of Ubuntu-based container images we call "rocks": minimal images engineered for performance and usability and backed by long-term security commitments. As a member of the team, you will own the path from upstream source to published image, turning open source software into tested, signed, and continuously maintained artifacts that developers can deploy with confidence.

This is fast-paced, multi-disciplinary software engineering. Because most of the software we package originates from third-party upstreams, you will work across a broad range of container technologies and hundreds of open source projects, often in several programming languages, integrating and maintaining them so they are easy to consume on Ubuntu. Automation is central to the role: you will build the pipelines that package, build, test, and publish images at scale.

Your seniority in this role will reflect your software engineering experience and your ability to mentor and guide more junior colleagues.

Location: This role is based in the EMEA region

This role entails

  • Build and maintain a growing portfolio of high-quality, hardened container images
  • Design and operate automated CI/CD pipelines that build, test, scan, sign, publish, promote, and retire images across environments and architectures
  • Write tooling and tests to assess security compliance and cloud-native compatibility
  • Work closely with the community and partners to share container expertise and keep our portfolio current with new features, patches, and applications
  • Collaborate with our product security, platform, infrastructure, and customer-facing teams
  • Contribute technical input to the team's decision-making
  • Set the standard for quality, defining image standards that span security, compatibility, performance, size, and developer experience
  • Grow our knowledge base and write about the work we do
  • Work in a collaborative, agile, and globally distributed environment
  • Mentor colleagues and contribute to hiring
  • Work from home with global travel of up to 15% for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • Proficiency in Bash and Python
  • Experience working with CI/CD systems (e.g. GitHub Actions, Jenkins)
  • Experience building container images
  • Command of at least one container management or orchestration tool (e.g. Docker, Podman, or Kubernetes)
  • Hands-on experience with Linux systems, package management, build systems, release engineering, or artifact pipelines
  • Clear communication and end-to-end ownership, spanning design, review, documentation, operation, and cross-team collaboration
  • A commitment to sharing knowledge and helping those around you grow
  • A genuine appetite for learning and for working outside your comfort zone
  • A Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, a STEM field, or a similar discipline
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Business level written and spoken English.
  • Sincere personal motivation aligned with our mission.
  • International travel 2-4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long.
  • 0-7 years relevant experience.

In addition we expect that you will match our values, by being:

  • Precise, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity.
  • Reliable, delivering high quality work that builds trust and confidence.
  • Accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable.
  • Adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character.

Nice-to-have skills

  • A security-oriented maintenance mindset: you can investigate dependency and vulnerability findings, assess their impact, and deliver a safe fix
  • An understanding of software supply chain security, with some experience generating and consuming artifacts such as SBOMs, signatures, provenance, or CVE reports
  • Familiarity with GitOps principles and workflows
  • Familiarity with additional languages such as Go or Rust
  • Hands-on experience building minimal and distroless container images
  • Knowledge of the OCI specifications
  • Familiarity with security or compliance frameworks such as CIS, NIST, FedRAMP, or DISA STIG
  • Evidence of contributions to open source projects
  • A passion for embedding security across all stages of the engineering lifecycle (DevSecOps), and an interest in using AI or agentic development responsibly and safely
  • Relevant Linux, container, or cloud-native certifications (such as CKS or DCA) are welcome

If your experience is close but does not match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We value transferable experience from Linux packaging, release engineering, build systems, platform engineering, and open-source maintenance.

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Bi-annual compensation review
  • Company recognition rewards
  • 40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
description: About Us The financial advisory industry is a $80T market in the US, but has seen little technological innovation compared to the self-service market (Robinhood, Betterment, Wealthfront, SoFi). Client data management is a universally painful and expensive problem for financial advisors. Today, advisors manually collect, update, and utilize client data across the 7-10 software tools that they use to run their business. Data transcription and translation across systems is time-consuming and error-prone, leading to costly inefficiencies and embarrassing client-facing problems. Managing data access control, audit logs, and compliance is a constant challenge, particularly in larger organizations. We are building the first wealth tech data orchestration company. We sync client data across a financial advisor's tech stack, unlocking the efficiency of a fully-integrated software suite with the choice of tools that best fit their business. We are laser-focused on enabling the best technology experiences for advisors and unlocking the potential of the entire wealth tech software ecosystem. We’re an experienced team of start-up operators with deep roots in both tech and advisory. You can learn more about us on our website . Role Details Role overview: We’re looking for an experienced fullstack engineer who can lead the development of our early product. You'll help evolve our engineering culture, take end-to-end ownership over the features that you build, and heavily influence the product roadmap and architecture decisions. Where you'll make an impact: Lead areas of development critical to the business, building features such as: self-service onboarding, data blending and deconfliction, and digital account opening. As an early employee, you'll have a large role to play in shaping the company's technical vision and product roadmap. Help us build and maintain a strong (and enjoyable!) developer experience. Ensure that the product operates smoothly in production, leveraging observability and monitoring tools to triage and resolve operational issues. Help hire and mentor other engineers as we build out our fast-growing team. Requirements: Strong track record of shipping high-quality systems with high complexity and scale. Experience building high-quality, delightful user-facing web applications. Experience working closely with a cross-functional product team. Excited to primarily be an individual contributor with a ton of ownership. You thrive in an early-stage, fast-paced environment with a high degree of ambiguity and agency. Impact-driven — you focus on the most important problems to solve and execute to deliver. You get shit done. Bias towards action and ownership – when you see a problem, you fix it. Customer-centric – you are focused on creating the best customer experience possible. Move fast — you can operate at breakneck speed and work furiously to ship, ship, ship. 7+ years of engineering experience. You’ll stand out if you have: Experience building B2B software and/or fintech software. Experience at seed/early-stage startups (eg, being a first-3 engineer at a company). Experience building and maintaining open source software. Previously started a company and/or launched personal projects. Experience with AI promting, models, and tools. raw.jobDescription:
About Us

The financial advisory industry is a $80T market in the US, but has seen little technological innovation compared to the self-service market (Robinhood, Betterment, Wealthfront, SoFi). Client data management is a universally painful and expensive problem for financial advisors. Today, advisors manually collect, update, and utilize client data across the 7-10 software tools that they use to run their business. Data transcription and translation across systems is time-consuming and error-prone, leading to costly inefficiencies and embarrassing client-facing problems. Managing data access control, audit logs, and compliance is a constant challenge, particularly in larger organizations.

We are building the first wealth tech data orchestration company. We sync client data across a financial advisor's tech stack, unlocking the efficiency of a fully-integrated software suite with the choice of tools that best fit their business. We are laser-focused on enabling the best technology experiences for advisors and unlocking the potential of the entire wealth tech software ecosystem. We’re an experienced team of start-up operators with deep roots in both tech and advisory. You can learn more about us on our website.

Role Details

Role overview:

We’re looking for an experienced fullstack engineer who can lead the development of our early product. You'll help evolve our engineering culture, take end-to-end ownership over the features that you build, and heavily influence the product roadmap and architecture decisions.

Where you'll make an impact:

  • Lead areas of development critical to the business, building features such as: self-service onboarding, data blending and deconfliction, and digital account opening.

  • As an early employee, you'll have a large role to play in shaping the company's technical vision and product roadmap.

  • Help us build and maintain a strong (and enjoyable!) developer experience.

  • Ensure that the product operates smoothly in production, leveraging observability and monitoring tools to triage and resolve operational issues.

  • Help hire and mentor other engineers as we build out our fast-growing team.

Requirements:

  • Strong track record of shipping high-quality systems with high complexity and scale.

  • Experience building high-quality, delightful user-facing web applications.

  • Experience working closely with a cross-functional product team.

  • Excited to primarily be an individual contributor with a ton of ownership.

  • You thrive in an early-stage, fast-paced environment with a high degree of ambiguity and agency.

  • Impact-driven — you focus on the most important problems to solve and execute to deliver. You get shit done.

  • Bias towards action and ownership – when you see a problem, you fix it.

  • Customer-centric – you are focused on creating the best customer experience possible.

  • Move fast — you can operate at breakneck speed and work furiously to ship, ship, ship.

  • 7+ years of engineering experience.

You’ll stand out if you have:

  • Experience building B2B software and/or fintech software.

  • Experience at seed/early-stage startups (eg, being a first-3 engineer at a company).

  • Experience building and maintaining open source software.

  • Previously started a company and/or launched personal projects.

  • Experience with AI promting, models, and tools. You are someone who not only leverages these in your work, but can help level-up our team.

Our tech stack:

React, Node, Fastify, MUI, React Query, Vite, Storybook, Playwright

Why Dispatch?

Why work at Dispatch?

  • We’re a highly experienced team with a track record of successfully building together. We’re well-versed in building for the best tech companies and asset managers.

  • We’re a well-funded company backed by top-tier investors.

  • We're laser-focused on customers and believe that a world-class user experience is critical for product and business success.

  • We move fast, iterate quickly, and have a high bar for what “excellent” looks like.

description:
About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

Role Overview

Crunchyroll is looking for an operational leader to serve as Director, Localisation & Operations. In this role, you will be responsible for building, scaling, and leading a multi-disciplinary team driving three core operational pillars: regional dubbing operations, platform content operations, and localized marketing operations. You will ensure that every piece of content—from full-length episodic anime to promotional trailers and fan communications—is delivered on time, at peak technical quality, and in an authentic local tone of voice. 

This role is ideal for an experienced media and post-production operations executive who thrives in ambiguity and enjoys bringing structure to a fast-paced, rapidly evolving environment. You are a builder at heart—someone who takes end-to-end ownership of complex challenges, isn't afraid to roll up their sleeves to optimize legacy systems, and excels at architecting robust, scalable processes from the ground up. You combine structured, data-driven leadership with a deep passion for global content regionalization, and you excel at evaluating complex vendor partnerships, establishing rigorous quality control standards, and building seamless workflows in fast-paced environments. 

You will be responsible for shaping Crunchyroll’s European operations collaborating cross-functionally with Global Centre’s of Excellence, Content Acquisition, Growth, Marketing teams to ensure anime fans in Europe enjoy premium, culturally nuanced experiences. 

The Localisation & Operations Team 

The Localisation & Operations team serves as the operational backbone powering Crunchyroll’s European business. By bridging raw media assets with multi-language execution, the team ensures millions of subscribers and territories receive synchronized, high-quality audio, subtitle, and marketing deliverables. The team’s mandate is to uphold localized creative integrity, optimize operational efficiency, and elevate brand authenticity to super-serve anime fans in Europe. 

Key Responsibilities

Regional Dubbing Operations & Vendor Strategy 

  • Lead the regional dubbing operational strategy, setting gold-standard benchmarks for quality across titles.
  • Source, evaluate, and manage ongoing relationships with external dubbing studios, post-production houses, and localisation agencies in the region.
  • Lead vendor negotiations to secure market-competitive rates, scalable capacity, and strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs) across multi-language projects.
  • Establish comprehensive Quality Control (QC) frameworks for dubbing assets to guarantee linguistic fidelity, regional slang/nuance accuracy, lip-sync alignment, and audio master standards.
  • Monitor vendor throughput, turnaround times, and error rates, implementing continuous process improvements for simuldub and deep catalog localization pipelines.

Content Operations, Ingestion & Scheduling 

  • Maintain a clear view of readiness across upcoming regional releases, including content assets, localized components, metadata, regulatory requirements, rights/avails, partner specifications, and publishing dependencies. Identify gaps early and coordinate resolution before they impact fans or partners.
  • Ensure all regionally required components are correctly ingested, associated, and published, including subtitles, dubs, closed captions, audio descriptions, localized metadata, and required regulatory or content-classification tags. 
  • Partner closely with Global Operations on title schedules, rights and avails, material readiness, asset availability, and technical requirements. 
  • Work closely with Global Localization and Regional Localization to ensure required localized outputs are available against regional launch schedules. 
  • Partner with Regional Marketing and other regional stakeholders to translate regional programming and launch priorities into operational schedules and delivery requirements.
  •  Track regional content-operations performance including on-time availability, publishing accuracy, delivery failures, remediation time, partner issues, and recurring defects. Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, eliminate manual work, and improve global-to-regional handoffs while adopting common global standards, tools, and operating practices.

Marketing Operations & Asset Localisation QC  

  • Oversee marketing asset localization operations, managing the pipeline for trailers, teasers, key art, digital banners, and social collateral across our key European territories.
  • Enforce rigorous QC across all customer-facing communications, ensuring localized copy, tone of voice, and brand messaging resonate natively within each specific market context.
  • Develop agile asset workflows capable of delivering rapid-turnaround localized creative materials for regional promotional initiatives.
  • Oversee the localization workflow for all global and regional marketing assets required by the Region, including copy, key art, trailers, video, social assets, paid-media creative, CRM materials, partner assets, promotional content, and other campaign deliverables.

Team Leadership & Operational Governance   

  • Build, mentor, and direct a high-performing operations team spanning dubbing, content ingestion, and marketing ops functions, fostering a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
  • Define, track, and report on primary operational KPIs (e.g., fulfillment throughput, unit costs, vendor turnarounds, QC pass/fail rates) to executive leadership.
  • Build business cases for infrastructure investments, automated tooling, and resource scaling to keep pace with growing catalog size and platform expansion.
  • Codify operational playbooks, SOPs, and cross-territorial standards to harmonize workflows across regional and global offices.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 12+ years of professional experience in content operations, localization, media supply chain, or post-production leadership within OTT/streaming, entertainment, or digital media platforms.
  • Proven track record leading multi-functional operations teams across localization/dubbing, asset management, content scheduling, and marketing operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to confidently navigate ambiguity, drive organizational change, and build scalable processes from scratch in a highly dynamic, high-growth environment. 
  • Extensive experience evaluating, onboarding, managing, and negotiating commercial agreements with global dubbing studios, post-production vendors, and localization agencies.
  • Deep technical understanding of media localization pipelines (dubbing, subtitling, audio mixing, lip-syncing), digital asset management (DAM), CMS systems, and video ingestion formats.
  • Demonstrated capability in building rigorous QC processes for customer-facing localized assets, upholding brand standards, and maintaining local cultural voice across multiple regions.
  • Strong analytical ability with hands-on experience utilizing operational dashboards, workflow metrics, and ROI analysis to streamline operations.
  • Proven experience operating effectively in a global, matrixed organization with cross-functional partners in multiple time zones.
  • Exceptional communication, leadership, and executive presentation skills.
  • Fluency in English required
  • Passion for anime, international pop culture, media, or entertainment ecosystems is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Media Production, Business Administration, or related field; MBA or Master's preferred.

Why you will love working at Crunchyroll

In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:

  • Receive a great compensation package including salary plus performance bonus earning potential, paid annually.
  • Flexible time off policies allowing you to take the time you need to be your whole self.
  • Generous medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance
  • Health Saving Account HSA program
  • Health care and dependent care FSA
  • Employer paid commuter benefit
  • Support program for new parents
  • Pet insurance and some of our offices are pet friendly!

About our Values

We want to be everything for someone rather than something for everyone and we do this by living and modeling our values in all that we do. We value

  • Courage. We believe that when we overcome fear, we enable our best selves.

  • Curiosity. We are curious, which is the gateway to empathy, inclusion, and understanding.

  • Kaizen. We have a growth mindset committed to constant forward progress.

  • Service. We serve our community with humility, enabling joy and belonging for others.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion

Our mission of helping people belong reflects our commitment to diversity & inclusion. It's just the way we do business.

title: Senior Marketing Manager, Integrated Marketing
description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Brand & Experience team builds the emotional connection between Deliveroo and our customers, riders, and partners. With a deep understanding of our audience and a passion for creativity, we bring our brand to life across every touchpoint. Whether it’s a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design—we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand.

We’re looking for a Senior Marketing Manager, Brand Integrated Marketing to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you’ll help us take ideas from global strategy through to local activation across markets, delivering integrated campaigns that drive measurable business growth.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the Integrated Marketing team. We own the Deliveroo brand globally and lead our biggest campaign moments. Working in a cross-functional squad alongside strategic teams, functional leads, and local markets, we turn big ideas into high-impact campaigns across our markets.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Global Campaign Ownership: Lead high-profile global marketing programmes and integrated campaigns from global strategy through to local market execution.

  • Framework & Playbook Development: Design, scale, and maintain measurement frameworks, playbooks, and systems that enable global and local teams to execute best-in-class brand campaigns.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with cross-functional squads, strategic teams, functional leads, and local market leads to align campaign strategies with core business goals.

  • Stakeholder Management: Influence senior stakeholders across the global organisation without direct authority, ensuring alignment on messaging, execution, and performance metrics.

  • Strategic Optimisation: Balance tactical execution with a longer-term strategic perspective to solve complex marketing briefs and continuously optimize brand performance.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Integrated Brand Leadership: Proven experience leading end-to-end global integrated marketing campaigns from initial strategy through to local market activation.

  • Framework Development: Strong track record in establishing measurement frameworks, campaign playbooks, and operational systems that scale across multiple regions.

  • Stakeholder Influence: Demonstrated ability to influence and align senior cross-functional stakeholders and matrix teams without direct line management authority.

  • Strategic & Tactical Execution: Proven ability to operate independently on complex or ambiguous briefs, balancing day-to-day execution with longer-term brand strategy.

  • Commercial Acumen: Strong expertise in linking brand initiatives and marketing campaigns directly to measurable business growth and commercial impact.

Nice to Have

  • Experience navigating three-sided marketplace dynamics or fast-paced consumer tech environments.

  • Background working across international or multi-market structures.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.
