Nous encourageons le feedback dans les deux sens, le développement de chacun et la prise d’initiative. Nous accordons de l’importance à l’autonomie, à la responsabilité et à la confiance, dans l’esprit de Community of Builders et de Radical Trust.

Concrètement, ton quotidien ressemblera à ça

  • Animer les points d’équipe et suivre la charge quotidienne.

  • Accompagner les agents sur leurs tickets, leurs priorités et leurs situations complexes.

  • Réaliser des écoutes ou analyses de conversations pour donner du feedback constructif.

  • Suivre les indicateurs de performance et de qualité de l’équipe, comme le temps de première réponse, le temps de résolution, la satisfaction client et le volume de tickets traités.

  • Participer aux rituels de pilotage opérationnel : suivi de la charge, priorisation des demandes, identification des alertes et coordination avec les autres équipes Support.

  • Remonter les irritants utilisateurs aux équipes Produit, Tech ou Ops.

  • Contribuer à améliorer les process, la documentation et les outils internes.

Responsabilités

  • Manager une équipe de 6 à 12 agents sous la supervision du Team Lead Support N2, en les accompagnant dans leur activité quotidienne, leur progression et leur épanouissement professionnel.

  • Donner des feedbacks clairs, réguliers et transparents, réaliser des écoutes et analyses de conversations, suivre les bilans et plans d’accompagnement individuels, proposer des coachings et identifier les besoins de formation.

  • Suivre les indicateurs de l’équipe et contribuer à la qualité du support, notamment le temps de première réponse, la satisfaction client, le temps de résolution, le volume traité, la prise en charge des nouveaux tickets et le suivi des tickets en cours.

  • Participer aux rituels de pilotage et à la gestion des files de demandes communes, notamment lors des rotations de permanence, en identifiant les alertes et en remontant les besoins de renfort ou d’arbitrage.

  • Être force de proposition pour optimiser les process, les outils, la documentation et les modes de fonctionnement du Support.

  • Collaborer avec les équipes support de niveau 1, l’équipe technique, les équipes opérationnelles ainsi que les équipes produit et tech, faire remonter les irritants utilisateurs et contribuer aux projets transverses.

  • Partager les bonnes pratiques avec les autres Associate Team Leads et contribuer à maintenir une communication fluide au sein du Support.

  • Prendre ponctuellement en charge des demandes internes urgentes ou des situations complexes nécessitant l’expertise du Support Niveau 2, en sachant orienter ou escalader lorsque cela est nécessaire.

Ce poste est fait pour toi si

  • Tu aimes accompagner une équipe et faire progresser les autres.

  • Tu sais garder du recul dans des situations opérationnelles parfois urgentes.

  • Tu es à l’aise avec les indicateurs, tout en gardant toujours en tête la qualité de l’expérience utilisateur.

  • Tu sais communiquer avec clarté, même quand les sujets sont complexes.

  • Tu as envie de contribuer à structurer une équipe Support dans un environnement en forte évolution.

Qualifications

  • Diplôme Bac+2 ou Bac+3 minimum en comptabilité, management ou dans un domaine équivalent.

  • Expérience d’au moins 1 an en management ou en accompagnement d’équipe, idéalement dans le secteur du support.

  • Bonne capacité à analyser une situation, prendre une décision mesurée et proposer des solutions concrètes.

  • Excellentes capacités de communication et de collaboration, avec assertivité et diplomatie.

  • Goût pour le feedback, la pédagogie et l’accompagnement individuel.

  • Aisance avec les outils informatiques, notamment les outils de ticketing et de documentation comme Intercom, Zendesk ou Notion.

  • Capacité à s’adapter à un environnement en évolution rapide.

  • Sens du service et attention portée à l’expérience utilisateur.

Les nice to have

Ces éléments sont un plus, mais ne sont pas indispensables si tu as une forte appétence pour le support, le management de proximité et l’apprentissage produit/métier.

  • Connaissances en comptabilité.

  • Expérience préalable en tant que contributeur individuel au sein d’une équipe Support.

  • Expérience dans un environnement SaaS ou start-up.

  • Expérience dans le management d’une équipe principalement à distance.

  • Expérience de collaboration avec des équipes Produit, Tech ou Ops.

  • Anglais niveau B1 minimum.

  • Utilisation de l’IA pour optimiser ses tâches.

raw.title: Head of Investment Fund Operations
raw.description:
We are seeking a highly experienced Head of Fund Operations to oversee the operational management of a diverse Swiss and Luxembourg fund portfolio within an established international private banking environment.

In this responsible leadership role, you will manage a small team of fund operations specialists and ensure reliable, accurate and efficient processes across fund data, cost management, NAV controls and reporting. You will work closely with internal stakeholders as well as fund administrators, system providers, auditors, tax advisors and other external partners. As a member of the Valuation Committee, you will also contribute your expertise to fund valuation-related decisions.

The position offers a combination of team leadership, fund operations expertise, data management, regulatory knowledge and process automation, with considerable scope to improve existing processes and further professionalise the operational setup.

Location: Basel

Your Responsibilities:

  • Manage and develop a team of three Fund Operations specialists and oversee operations for the complete Swiss and Luxembourg fund portfolio

  • Ensure the availability, integrity and quality of fund data across the relevant internal systems

  • Monitor end-to-end data flows and act as the key contact for the external system provider

  • Review and validate important fund indicators such as TER, PTR, OGC and transaction costs

  • Take ownership of the PRIIPs KID production process and ensure that the underlying information is accurate and up to date

  • Manage the relationship with CACEIS concerning NAV data, including plausibility controls and the investigation and resolution of discrepancies

  • Participate in valuation-related decisions as an active member of the Valuation Committee

  • Coordinate the preparation and publication of annual and semi-annual fund reports

  • Liaise with auditors and tax advisors and oversee relevant fund-related tax topics

  • Review fund-related invoices and ensure transparency and accuracy of associated costs

  • Coordinate the preparation of factsheets, monthly fund manager reports and regular reporting for wholesale clients

  • Analyse existing processes and identify opportunities for greater efficiency, automation and data quality

  • Drive the use of automation and data-driven approaches to improve fund operations and reporting

  • Ensure that operational processes and reporting activities are aligned with applicable Swiss and Luxembourg regulatory requirements

  • Serve as a knowledgeable and reliable contact for internal stakeholders and external service providers across fund operations

Your Profile:

  • At least 7 years of relevant professional experience in fund operations, fund controlling, fund accounting, fund administration or fund audit

  • Comprehensive knowledge of the Swiss and Luxembourg fund landscape, ideally including CISA, FINMA, AMAS, UCITS and CSSF regulations

  • Practical experience with NAV control and oversight and cooperation with external fund administrators

  • Previous experience with CACEIS is considered an advantage

  • Strong knowledge of fund reporting, data management, valuation processes and fund-related cost structures

  • Good technical capabilities, including Python or a comparable scripting language, advanced Excel and experience working with databases and SQL

  • Experience in automating operational, data or reporting processes is highly desirable

  • Strong analytical skills and a precise, structured approach to complex data and processes

  • A proactive, hands-on working style with a high degree of personal responsibility

  • Previous leadership or people management experience is an advantage

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across different functions and organisations

  • High level of integrity, reliability and accountability

  • Comfortable working in an international, regulated financial services environment

  • University or FH degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Accounting or a comparable discipline

  • Excellent English skills; German and French are advantageous

What We Offer:

  • A senior position with broad responsibility for the operational management of a Swiss and Luxembourg fund portfolio

  • The opportunity to shape and further improve the Fund Operations function and its processes

  • A varied role combining leadership, fund operations, data and automation

  • Regular interaction with senior internal stakeholders and key external partners

  • The opportunity to contribute to the Valuation Committee and support important fund-related decisions

  • Significant scope to introduce process improvements and strengthen automation and data quality

  • An international environment within an established and reputable private banking organisation

  • Flexible working arrangements and a modern working environment

  • Opportunities for continued professional and personal development

title: Technicien CVC Frigoriste Datacenter H/F
description: MDC RECRUTEMENT, cabinet de recrutement référence dans la filière Datacenter, recherche pour son client, opérateur d’infrastructures de calcul et d’énergie de très forte puissance dédiées à l’intelligence artificielle, un TECHNICIEN CVC FRIGORISTE SENIOR H/F. Vos missions Au cœur de salles techniques où l’arrêt n’est pas une option, vous faites tourner la production de froid et de climatisation en lien avec les équipes d’exploitation et de maintenance : Maintenance du froid et du CVC : vous planifiez et réalisez les opérations préventives et les réparations sur les groupes froid, la ventilation, le chauffage et la climatisation. Recherche de pannes : vous remontez à la cause réelle d’une défaillance, vous rétablissez l’équipement et vous évitez qu’elle se reproduise. Réaction sur incident : vous êtes en première ligne quand un événement technique menace le fonctionnement du site, pour maintenir le service sans interruption. Coordination des prestataires : vous accompagnez les entreprises extérieures sur site, vous validez la qualité de leurs interventions et vous veillez au respect des règles de sécurité. Surveillance des équipements : vous effectuez des tournées de contrôle pour repérer les dérives avant qu’elles ne deviennent des pannes. Efficacité énergétique : vous lisez les relevés de fonctionnement, vous suivez les rendements des installations et vous proposez des pistes pour consommer moins. Culture sécurité : vous appliquez les procédures d’exploitation et les standards HSE du site, et vous les faites vivre auprès de vos interlocuteurs. Progrès continu : vous remontez vos idées pour fiabiliser et moderniser le parc. Le profil recherché Prérequis : 8 ans d’expérience minimum indispensables en maintenance d’installations CVC ou de froid industriel. Attestation de manipulation des fluides frigorigènes (catégorie I) exigée, ainsi qu’une habilitation électrique (BR, B1/B2 ou équivalent) exigée. Résidence à Grenoble ou à proximité immédiate impérative : seules les personnes déjà installées dans le bassin grenoblois seront étudiées. Compétences attendues : Maîtrise de la recherche de pannes et de la maintenance sur équipements de production de froid et de CVC. Pratique des bases d’électricité, de régulation ou d’automatisme appliquées au génie climatique. Aisance requise dans la lecture de plans et schémas hydrauliques, frigorifiques et électriques. Pratique de la supervision d’intervenants extérieurs et du respect de procédures d’exploitation strictes. Atouts appréciés : Idéalement, un passage par un datacenter ou un autre site critique à très haute disponibilité. Un diplôme du niveau Bac Pro à Licence professionnelle en génie climatique, froid ou maintenance industrielle est souhaité. L’exploitation de données de fonctionnement pour piloter des performances est appréciée. Un anglais technique est un plus. title: Stage Mechatronica: EPLAN Fluid
description: Wat ga je doen? Tijdens deze stageopdracht duik je in de huidige manier van werken rondom hydrauliek- en pneumatiekschema’s binnen NPD Mechanical Engineering. Op dit moment worden de schema’s opgesteld op een manier die niet-configureerbaar is en beperkte mogelijkheden biedt, bijvoorbeeld als het gaat om het printen en hergebruiken van coderingen. Je onderzoekt hoe EPLAN Fluid het beste ingezet kan worden om de huidige aanpak eventueel te vervangen. Daarbij kijk je niet alleen naar “hoe het kan”, maar vooral naar “hoe het moet”. Je werkt hierbij samen met engineers en krijgt de ruimte om zelf initiatief te nemen. Je sluit af met een proof of concept: een volledig hydraulisch en pneumatisch machineschema dat als referentie kan dienen voor nieuwe machineontwikkeling. Mogelijke onderdelen van je opdracht: In kaart brengen van de huidige werkwijze en knelpunten rond hydrauliek- en pneumatiekschema’s; Opstellen van een gestandaardiseerde werkwijze; Verkennen van configuratie- en documentatiemogelijkheden binnen EPLAN Fluid; Bouwen van een proof of concept als referentie; Opleveren van een korte handleiding en overdracht naar de engineers. Wij vragen Een HBO-opleiding in de richting van Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar. Wij bieden Een vergoeding: €600,- per maand; Reiskostenvergoeding: zodat jij geen onnodige kosten maakt; Apparatuur en materialen: bijvoorbeeld een laptop, speciaal gereedschap of software; Ervaren coach: goede begeleiding is belangrijk en dus krijg je een vaste coach om je te ondersteunen; Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Over Voortman Wat in 1968 begon in een kippenschuur in Rijssen, is uitgegroeid tot wereldspeler in CNC-staalbewerkingsmachines. Met een team van meer dan 750 collega’s wereldwijd ontwikkelen en bouwen we niet alleen high-end machines, maar ook slimme software en service waarop klanten kunnen vertrouwen. Deze 3 krachtige bouwstenen maken ons Twentse, internationale familiebedrijf uniek. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
description: Wat ga je doen? Samen met de CEO en COO werk je aan de verdere strategische en financiële ontwikkeling van de organisatie. Als CFO vertaal je de ondernemingsstrategie naar concrete groeikansen door schaalbare verdien- en prijsmodellen te ontwikkelen. Per markt, regio, entiteit, businessunit en klantsegment analyseer je waar kansen liggen, op basis van verwachte klantwaarde, omzetpotentieel, kosten, marge, cashflow, risico en schaalbaarheid. Deze inzichten verwerk je in businesscases waarin zowel het perspectief van de klant als van Voortman Steel Machinery naar voren komen. Daarnaast ontwikkel je heldere investeringskaders en breng je passende financieringsmodellen in kaart die aansluiten op de aard van de activiteiten en de internationale context. Daarbij weeg je beschikbare financieringsopties zorgvuldig af op impact, liquiditeit en rendement. Op basis daarvan adviseer je de board over prioriteiten en zorg je dat middelen terechtkomen bij de initiatieven die het meest bijdragen aan de strategische en financiële doelstellingen van Voortman Steel Machinery. Als onderdeel hiervan bepaal je ook onder welke financiële en organisatorische voorwaarden pilots kunnen worden gestart en opgeschaald. Met heldere go/no-go-momenten per fase zorg je ervoor dat de ontwikkeling en implementatie van nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen niet sneller gaat dan wat de organisatie kan adopteren. Daarnaast monitor je de financiële resultaten van nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen en bepaal je of de uitrol moet worden versneld, voortgezet, bijgestuurd of afgeschaald. Tegelijkertijd borg je dat contracten allesomvattende afspraken en een evenwichtige risicoverdeling bevatten, evenals uitvoerbaar zijn in alle landen waar Voortman Steel Machinery actief is. Zo werk je gericht aan verdien- en prijsmodellen die commercieel aantrekkelijk, financieel gezond en schaalbaar zijn. Als CFO draag je actief bij aan de verdere internationale groei van Voortman Steel Machinery. Hiervoor ontwikkel je strategische, financiële en organisatorische plannen, zodat per markt en internationale entiteit helder is welke inrichting het beste past bij de gewenste groei. Daarbij verzorg je de afstemming tussen verschillende afdelingen en entiteiten, zonder de lijnverantwoordelijkheid van collega's over te nemen. Tevens bewaak je per land en internationale entiteit het rendement, de cashflow, het werkkapitaal en houd je zicht op financiële, juridische, fiscale, contractuele en compliance-risico’s. Ook de financiële besturing en beheersing van Voortman Steel Machinery valt onder jouw verantwoordelijkheid. Je bent internationaal eindverantwoordelijk voor consolidatie, planning & control, reporting, accounting, treasury, audit, tax, vennootschapsbelasting en interne beheersing. Aansluitend zie je toe op het opstellen van correcte en transparante rapportages per internationale entiteit. De dagelijkse coördinatie van deze verschillende activiteiten en de aansturing van de Finance-afdeling wordt verzorgd door de Finance-director, waarmee je nauw samenwerkt. Jij fungeert als sparringpartner, stuurt bij waar nodig, bewaakt de strategisch richting van de Finance-afdeling, verzorgt correcte governance en behandeld onderwerpen met board impact. Tevens ben je het gezicht van Voortman Steel Machinery richting banken, verzekeraars, accountant en andere financiële stakeholders. Wat maakt deze rol uniek? In deze rol krijg je de kans om zichtbaar richting te geven aan de volgende groeifase van Voortman Steel Machinery. Je komt terecht in een organisatie waar ondernemerschap, innovatie en slagkracht samenkomen: ideeën worden niet alleen verkend, maar ook scherp getoetst op waardecreatie, rendement, risico en schaalbaarheid. Daarmee krijg je ruimte om jouw financiële expertise en strategisch vermogen in te zetten bij het ontwikkelen van nieuwe proposities, het onderbouwen van businesscases en het bepalen van investeringskeuzes die impact hebben op de internationale groei van de organisatie. Dit maakt de functie nadrukkelijk méér dan een traditionele CFO-rol: je bewaakt niet alleen de financiële basis, maar bent medebepalend in hoe Voortman Steel Machinery commerciële kansen vertaalt naar gezonde, schaalbare en toekomstbestendige groei. Positie binnen de organisatie Voortman Steel Machinery ontwikkelt machines, software en serviceoplossingen waarmee staalverwerkende bedrijven hun productieprocessen automatiseren en optimaliseren. Het hoofdkantoor is gevestigd in Nederland. Dankzij vestigingen in verschillende landen kan effectieve lokale ondersteuning worden geboden. De recent geopende, grootschalige productielocatie in de Verenigde Staten laat zien hoe de organisatie internationaal blijft groeien. Tevens vindt in Engeland hoofdzakelijk de ontwikkeling van onze LogicSteel-software plaats. Daarnaast bezit Voortman wereldwijd diverse sales & service-hubs. Als CFO vorm je samen met de CEO en COO de board van Voortman Steel Machinery, geef je met hen richting aan de ontwikkeling van het Global Management Team en de organisatie als geheel. Jouw focus ligt op het vertalen van de ondernemingsstrategie naar concrete kansen voor nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen. Hierbij werk je intensief samen met de afdeling Product Management, dat verantwoordelijk is voor het identificeren en ontwikkelen van software-, machine- en serviceproposities. Als CFO ben je eindverantwoordelijk voor de Finance-afdeling en werk je nauw samen met de Finance Director, die de dagelijkse internationale operationele aansturing van de afdeling verzorgt. Tevens rapporteren de HR-Manager en Trade Compliance Officer aan jou. De HR-Manager is (mede) verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen van de HR-strategie en het borgen van de operationele uitvoering. Daarnaast ziet de Trade Compliance Officer erop toe dat de organisatie voldoet aan de relevante wet- en regelgeving. Daarbij bewaakt de Trade Compliance Officer onder andere de inhoudelijke juistheid en werking van ingezette maatregelen. Wat wij bieden? Bij Voortman Steel Machinery kom je terecht in een écht familiebedrijf met een informele, betrokken en ondernemende cultuur. Mensen kennen elkaar en lijnen zijn kort. Er is volop ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, initiatief te tonen en ideeën verder te brengen. Onze kernwaarden ondernemerschap, vakmanschap, passie voor technologie, toewijding en samenwerking vormen daarbij de basis voor hoe we werken en met elkaar omgaan. Je ziet ze terug in de trots waarmee we hoogwaardige technologie ontwikkelen, in de manier waarop teams elkaar versterken en in de gezamenlijke drive om klanten vooruit te helpen. Zo ontstaat een werkomgeving waarin ambitie, betrokkenheid en werkplezier op een natuurlijke manier samenkomen. Naast een professionele, ondernemende en loyale werkomgeving krijg je bij ons: Een marktconform salaris, passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring; Een passende pensioenregeling bij ASR, waarbij jij en Voortman samen pensioenkapitaal opbouwen; Een leaseauto voor zakelijk en privégebruik; Een sleutelrol in het realiseren van onze strategie met internationale impact; Werken in een moderne omgeving op onze Voortman Campus in Rijssen; Wat breng je mee? Wij zoeken een ondernemende, strategische en daadkrachtige CFO met een afgeronde masteropleiding in Finance, Economie, Bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare richting. Een titel als RA, RC of CPA is een must. Je hebt minimaal vijf jaar ervaring als CFO, Divisie-CFO, Senior Finance Director, Head of Finance of Director Corporate Finance, bij voorkeur binnen een internationale original equipment manufacturer (OEM), industrieel technologiebedrijf, technisch complexe B2B-organisatie of top-tier consultancybureau. Ervaring binnen een ondernemend familiebedrijf of een organisatie van vergelijkbare omvang en complexiteit is daarbij een pré. Daarnaast heb je ervaring met aansturen van een finance-afdeling of -team. Verder voldoe je aan het volgende profiel: Strategisch en analytisch vermogen: je beschikt over sterk analytisch en strategisch vermogen en hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het doorgronden van complexe data en businessmodellen. Je weet informatie te vertalen naar heldere strategische en financiële logica, logische transparante aannames en goed onderbouwde besluitvorming. Je bent in staat om richting te bepalen, langetermijndoelen te formuleren en de organisatie daarin mee te nemen. Businessmodelinnovatie: je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het in kaart brengen van groeikansen en het ontwikkelen van nieuwe (schaalbare) verdien-, prijs- en contractmodellen. Deze weet je te onderbouwen met solide businesscases en scenarioanalyses. Daarnaast heb je ruime ervaring met het ontwikkelen van financieringsmodellen en het inrichten van kapitaalallocatie op basis van het (verwachte) rendement, risico’s en strategische bijdrage. Besluitvaardig en resultaatgericht: je bent besluitvaardig en kunt tijdig en doordacht keuzes maken op basis van beschikbare informatie. Als je éénmaal een keuze hebt gemaakt, durf je achter je keuze te blijven staan. Je beschikt over overtuigingskracht, kunt draagvlak creëren en interne en externe stakeholders zorgvuldig meenemen in strategische veranderingen. Tevens stuur je actief op concrete resultaten en realiseer je aantoonbare positieve financiële impact. Verandervermogen en omgevingsbewustzijn: je hebt ervaring met het realiseren van interne veranderingen en de implementatie van nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen, evenals het tijdig bijsturen daarvan. Tevens ben je sterk in het vertalen van nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen naar heldere, beheersbare processen en rollen. Daarbij zorg je voor een gestructureerde stapsgewijze implementatie en ben je sterk in het meenemen en begeleiden van collega’s tijdens veranderingen. Ook onder druk en in complexe situaties blijf je rustig, behoud je overzicht en kun je snel schakelen. Tevens heb je een scherp oog voor verhoudingen, kun je belangen goed afwegen en anticipeer je tijdig op ontwikkelingen. Daarbij heb je een goed begrip van culturele en organisatorische verschillen in een internationale context. Verbindend vermogen en communicatie: je bent betrokken en weet duurzame professionele relaties op te bouwen en te onderhouden met interne en externe stakeholders, zoals banken, accountants en verzekeraars. Je communiceert helder, informeert betrokkenen tijdig over relevante ontwikkelingen en bent benaderbaar. Je weet complexe onderwerpen begrijpelijk over te brengen en stemt je communicatie af op verschillende gesprekspartners. Daarnaast beschik je over sterke Nederlandse en Engelse communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Inspirerend leiderschap: jouw leiderschap is gericht op groei, vertrouwen en ontwikkeling. Je weet medewerkers te coachen, te inspireren en richting te geven, terwijl je ruimte geeft voor eigenaarschap en verantwoordelijkheid. Daarbij stuur je bij waar nodig, stimuleer je samenwerking en help je collega’s hun potentieel te benutten. Zo draag je bij aan een omgeving waarin mensen zich betrokken voelen en werken aan gezamenlijke doelen. Onafhankelijke en reflectieve houding: je hebt een onafhankelijke, kritische en constructieve houding, staat open voor feedback, kunt je eigen handelen kritisch evalueren en wilt continu blijven leren. Nieuwsgierig? Ben jij dé ondernemende en daadkrachtige Chief Financial Officer (CFO) die strategie weet te vertalen naar waarde, nieuwe verdienmodellen tot leven brengt, internationale groei mede realiseert en de organisatie met visie en resultaatgerichtheid stuurt? Solliciteer dan nu en word onderdeel van onze organisatie! Na ontvangst beoordelen wij jouw sollicitatie en nemen we binnen twee werkdagen contact met je op. Zijn wij net als jij positief, dan nodigen we je graag uit voor een eerste sollicitatiegesprek op locatie. Bij een positieve uitkomst volgt een tweede en mogelijk derde sollicitatiegesprek. Ter voorbereiding op het derde sollicitatiegesprek willen we je vragen een assessment te maken, waarmee meer inzicht wordt verkregen in jouw cognitieve capaciteiten, drijfveren en persoonlijkheid. Met jouw goedkeuring bespreken we vervolgens de uitkomsten, behandelen we een casus en wordt een referentie- en achtergrondcheck uitgevoerd. Wil je eerst meer weten over de functie, Voortman Steel Machinery of sollicitatieprocedure, neem dan contact op met Guus Regelink via of 0626393850. Wat breng je mee?

Ervaring binnen een ondernemend familiebedrijf of een organisatie van vergelijkbare omvang en complexiteit is daarbij een pré. Daarnaast heb je ervaring met aansturen van een finance-afdeling of -team. Verder voldoe je aan het volgende profiel:

 

  • Strategisch en analytisch vermogen: je beschikt over sterk analytisch en strategisch vermogen en hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het doorgronden van complexe data en businessmodellen. Je weet informatie te vertalen naar heldere strategische en financiële logica, logische transparante aannames en goed onderbouwde besluitvorming. Je bent in staat om richting te bepalen, langetermijndoelen te formuleren en de organisatie daarin mee te nemen.

 

  • Businessmodelinnovatie: je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het in kaart brengen van groeikansen en het ontwikkelen van nieuwe (schaalbare) verdien-, prijs- en contractmodellen. Deze weet je te onderbouwen met solide businesscases en scenarioanalyses. Daarnaast heb je ruime ervaring met het ontwikkelen van financieringsmodellen en het inrichten van kapitaalallocatie op basis van het (verwachte) rendement, risico’s en strategische bijdrage.

 

  • Besluitvaardig en resultaatgericht: je bent besluitvaardig en kunt tijdig en doordacht keuzes maken op basis van beschikbare informatie. Als je éénmaal een keuze hebt gemaakt, durf je achter je keuze te blijven staan. Je beschikt over overtuigingskracht, kunt draagvlak creëren en interne en externe stakeholders zorgvuldig meenemen in strategische veranderingen. Tevens stuur je actief op concrete resultaten en realiseer je aantoonbare positieve financiële impact.

 

  • Verandervermogen en omgevingsbewustzijn: je hebt ervaring met het realiseren van interne veranderingen en de implementatie van nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen, evenals het tijdig bijsturen daarvan. Tevens ben je sterk in het vertalen van nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen naar heldere, beheersbare processen en rollen. Daarbij zorg je voor een gestructureerde stapsgewijze implementatie en ben je sterk in het meenemen en begeleiden van collega’s tijdens veranderingen. Ook onder druk en in complexe situaties blijf je rustig, behoud je overzicht en kun je snel schakelen. Tevens heb je een scherp oog voor verhoudingen, kun je belangen goed afwegen en anticipeer je tijdig op ontwikkelingen. Daarbij heb je een goed begrip van culturele en organisatorische verschillen in een internationale context.

 

  • Verbindend vermogen en communicatie: je bent betrokken en weet duurzame professionele relaties op te bouwen en te onderhouden met interne en externe stakeholders, zoals banken, accountants en verzekeraars. Je communiceert helder, informeert betrokkenen tijdig over relevante ontwikkelingen en bent benaderbaar. Je weet complexe onderwerpen begrijpelijk over te brengen en stemt je communicatie af op verschillende gesprekspartners. Daarnaast beschik je over sterke Nederlandse en Engelse communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

 

  • Inspirerend leiderschap: jouw leiderschap is gericht op groei, vertrouwen en ontwikkeling. Je weet medewerkers te coachen, te inspireren en richting te geven, terwijl je ruimte geeft voor eigenaarschap en verantwoordelijkheid. Daarbij stuur je bij waar nodig, stimuleer je samenwerking en help je collega’s hun potentieel te benutten. Zo draag je bij aan een omgeving waarin mensen zich betrokken voelen en werken aan gezamenlijke doelen.

 

  • Onafhankelijke en reflectieve houding: je hebt een onafhankelijke, kritische en constructieve houding, staat open voor feedback, kunt je eigen handelen kritisch evalueren en wilt continu blijven leren.

 

Nieuwsgierig?

You hit targets. But what you really want is to build.

You know how to deliver ARR targets. What really gets you going is building a sales organisation that’s ready for the next stage of growth. Sound like you? Read on.

  

Your role
As Sales Director, you’re the CCO’s operational and tactical right hand on sales management. The CCO holds ultimate responsibility for the group result and the strategic relationships. You make sure we deliver our ARR targets, day in, day out. You keep the sales team sharp, focused and on track. Customer Success and expansion also fall under your leadership.

This is explicitly more than running today’s team. You help build tomorrow’s. You translate the group’s growth strategy (vertical specialisation, internationalisation and portfolio expansion) into the commercial capacity and structure we’ll need next. You also help build the playbook that lets sales teams from new acquisitions integrate smoothly into the group.

You report to the CCO. Together with the CCO and the Marketing Director, you form the Commercial MT (CMT). You also work closely with the Leadership Team (LT).

Day to day, you and the Marketing Director make sure the commercial disciplines work together seamlessly: from lead to pipeline to revenue. You make clear agreements on MQLs, SQLs and forecasting. That collaboration has to be ultra-tight.

What you’ll do
Revenue & results

You’re operationally responsible for delivering the group’s ARR targets, day in, day out. That covers new business, upsell and cross-sell, and retention and expansion through Customer Success.

You translate the commercial strategy (set with and by the CCO and the Commercial MT) into concrete sales goals, targets per country and team, and an actionable sales plan.

You drive pipeline, conversion and forecast accuracy. You own the sales funnel from SQL to closed-won, and the expansion funnel within our existing customer base.

You’re responsible for pricing and deal structure within the agreed framework, in line with our margin and growth targets.

Leadership & team
+ You lead and further professionalise the sales team (about 15 FTE) day to day, across all countries where Whitevision operates. That includes visiting our offices and teams at the various locations.
+ You directly lead Customer Success (currently 2 FTE) as part of the broader sales and expansion motion. As the team grows, this structure can grow with it.
+ You decide on team structure, capacity and how accounts and verticals are divided, to fit our international growth.
+ You coach, develop and recruit sales professionals. You also own onboarding and enablement for new colleagues.
+ You drive individual and team performance with clear KPIs and a healthy rhythm of 1:1s, forecast reviews and pipeline meetings.

Building & integrating
+ You set up and safeguard scalable sales processes, CRM and tooling that grow with a fast-growing, international buy-and-build organisation.
+ You own the sales methodology, from qualification through negotiation to closing. You make sure every country and team applies it the same way.
+ You (co-)develop and execute the playbook for integrating sales teams of newly acquired companies: one sales methodology, one CRM, one way of working.
+ You spot operational bottlenecks in the commercial organisation and resolve them.

Collaboration & execution
+ You work closely with the Marketing Director on lead follow-up, campaign ROI, events, partners and a consistent go-to-market.
+ You support the CCO in the commercial execution of strategic partnerships, including AFAS, 4PS, Exact and other partners.
+ You report on sales performance, pipeline and risks to the CCO and the Commercial MT.
+ You travel regularly to our international teams and customers.

About Whitevision

Whitevision is a fast-growing SaaS organisation. We specialise in intelligent document processing and automating document-intensive workflows. Through an ambitious buy-and-build strategy, we’re bringing several software companies together into one strong, international platform. We’re active across Europe, and the US is likely next.

Our mission is clear: build one strong, recognisable and scalable company. One Company. The coming years are all about international growth, integration and commercial professionalisation. For this next phase, we’re looking for a Sales Director who doesn’t just deliver results, but also builds the organisation that makes the next stage of growth possible.

"At Whitevision, we provide a solution that genuinely helps people move forward in their organizations. It enables them to work more efficiently and effectively, allowing them to make a greater impact. Our team is stable and consists of a great mix of experience, personalities, and backgrounds. That diversity is one of our strengths. We also enjoy spending time together outside of work, whether it's a game of padel or a limoncello workshop." Erik, Sales Manager 


What you bring
+ 2–4 years of sales management experience, including at least one year in an end-responsible role (Sales Director or Head of Sales) in B2B SaaS or software.
+ A successful track record of at least 4 years as an individual contributor in SaaS sales.
+ A proven track record of hitting MRR/ARR targets and scaling a sales team in a fast-growing environment.
+ Experience (co-)building a sales organisation. You’ve put structure, process and capacity in place for the next phase, not just run an existing team.
+ You’re data- and process-driven. You build processes, rhythm and discipline, and you steer on data and forecasts.
+ An affinity for Customer Success and retention, alongside new business sales.
+ Experience leading sales teams across multiple countries and cultures. You’re a leader people want to follow, and the teams you’ve led will tell you so.
+ Experience in a scale-up or buy-and-build SaaS environment is a strong plus.
+ You’re a natural sparring partner for marketing. You think in terms of the full funnel, not just your own team.
+ Excellent English. Good Dutch is a plus, as is fluency in a third European language.

Our Whitevision way of working is built on respect, decisiveness, commitment and ambition. These core values are an excellent match with your personality and the way you approach your work. 

 

 

What we offer
+ OTE of €150,000 per year, depending on your experience. We’ll discuss the split, accelerators and caps on the variable part together.
+ A company car, laptop, mobile phone and a solid pension plan.
+ An executive role with direct, operational impact on our commercial result and on building a fast-growing international SaaS organisation.
+ Close collaboration in a small, decisive Commercial MT: the CCO, the Marketing Director and you.
+ The chance to help build tomorrow’s Sales and Customer Success organisation, including integrating new acquisitions.

 

Ready to drive our commercial engine?
Are you the Sales Director who’ll drive Whitevision’s commercial engine? Can you see yourself forming the Commercial MT with the CCO and the Marketing Director? Then we’d love to hear from you.

description: About Welocalize Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale. Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com ROLE OVERVIEW We are looking for a Kazakh Localization QA Tester / Proofreader to join a long-term. As a Linguistic Tester, you’ll help bring high-quality Kazakh content to life and ensure it feels natural, accurate, and polished for end users. Your main focus will be reviewing and refining localized content, making sure it reads smoothly and is free from errors. This includes checking grammar, spelling, punctuation, consistency, formatting, and cultural or contextual accuracy. You’ll also work hands-on with products by executing test cases, identifying localization bugs, and reporting issues through internal bug-tracking systems. IDEAL BACKGROUNDS: Marketing, Journalism, Copy Editing, Proofreading, Writing, Translation, and/or Localization Job Reference: #LI-JC1 Compensation Additional Information

title: QA/DevOps Engineer
description: Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games. We are seeking a QA/DevOps Engineer to join Discord’s Business Systems team. In this role, you will own automated test suite development and maintenance across Oracle ERP Cloud (Fusion) and Salesforce, with a focus on Tosca-based regression and progression testing. You will embed automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and partner closely with ERP Functional, Technical, and DevOps teams to ensure every release is tested consistently and defects are caught early. What you'll be doing Run Oracle ERP Cloud and Salesforce QA automation suites for all quarterly patch upgrades end-to-end. Review new Oracle and SFDC release features and recommend improvements to existing testing processes. Build and improve regression and progression test automation in the Tosca environment for Oracle Fusion and Salesforce. Create, maintain, and update Tosca scripts to reflect system and process changes across GL, AP, AR, and FAH modules. Lead feature enhancement reviews as part of quarterly patch assessment cycles and new enhancement projects. Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines; trigger regression suites automatically on every release candidate build. Maintain test infrastructure and environments in collaboration with DevOps and ERP Technical teams. Document test coverage, defect trends, and release readiness in Jira and shared reporting dashboards. Automation Use Cases FAH Process Automation: Auto-test Financial Accounting Hub on each new sales item addition to eliminate manual unit testing. AR Regression Suite: Automated flows for invoicing, receipts, and customer setup across every release. AP Regression Suite: Payment runs, supplier invoices, holds, and approvals tested automatically on each patch cycle. Salesforce Tosca Automation: Develop, maintain, and expand automated SFDC test suites in Tosca, integrated with release pipelines. What you should have 3-5+ years of QA automation experience. Hands-on Tosca experience for regression and progression test suite development and maintenance. Experience executing and maintaining automated test cycles for quarterly Oracle patch upgrades. Familiarity with Oracle ERP Cloud and SFDC release feature review and technical impact assessment. Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or equivalent). Familiarity with pipeline configuration: triggering regression runs on pull requests and release candidate builds. Working knowledge of version control (Git / GitHub or GitLab): branching, pull requests, and code review workflows. Basic scripting capability in Python, Shell, or PowerShell for test utility automation and pipeline support. Understanding of containerized test environments (Docker); experience running tests in ephemeral containers is a plus. Jira for defect tracking, test coverage reporting, and sprint participation. Experience writing and maintaining test documentation: test plans, test cases, regression logs, and release readiness summaries. Ability to work cross-functionally with ERP Functional Analysts, ERP Technical Developers, and DevOps engineers. Familiarity with SOX compliance, ITGC controls, and ERP change management practices. Preferred Qualifications Oracle Fusion certification or formal training in Oracle ERP Cloud modules. Experience with SaaS QA automation in a high-growth technology company environment. Exposure to OIC (Oracle Integration Cloud) or MuleSoft integration testing. Familiarity with Salesforce test automation frameworks beyond Tosca (Selenium, Provar, or equivalent). Prior experience working with AMS or managed services vendors in an ERP context. Knowledge of Oracle quarterly release cycles and technical impact assessments. Exposure to infrastructure-as-code or environment provisioning concepts (Terraform, Ansible). This position is US-based and can be remote but if you live in the Bay Area, you’re welcome to work from our beautiful SF office. The US base salary range for this full-time position is $156,000 to $175,500 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits. Why Discord? Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away! Discord is committed to inclusion and providing reasonable accommodations during the interview process. We want you to feel set up for success, so if you are in need of reasonable accommodations, please let your recruiter know. Please see our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy for details regarding Discord’s collection and usage of personal information relating to the application and recruitment process by clicking HERE.

TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. What we’re looking for:

  • Experience designing and building scalable backend systems, APIs, web services, and production software.

  • Strong understanding of third-party API integration patterns, including authentication, rate limits, retries, error handling, data normalization, and monitoring.

  • Experience with storage systems such as relational databases, analytical databases, queues, caches, or event-driven architectures.

  • Ability to work through ambiguity, structure complex problems, and identify the highest-impact technical priorities.

  • Strong ownership mindset and comfort driving projects from vague requirements through production launch and iteration.

  • Ability to communicate complex technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience working collaboratively in a cross-functional environment with product, design, data, infrastructure, and customer-facing teams.

  • Experience with OSINT data sources a plus

  • Experience with AI Production Systems a plus

About the Team:

  • The AI Engineering team builds the systems, workflows, and infrastructure behind TRM’s AI-native products. This role sits on the team focused on third-party integrations and the scalable platform that enables TRM to connect to external data sources quickly, reliably, and securely.

  • The team operates on a weekly sprint schedule. Engineers are expected to lead projects as technical anchors and are given opportunities to grow ownership according to their level and goals.

  • We work closely with product, design, data platform, infrastructure, and customer-facing teams to deliver capabilities that directly impact customers and internal users.

  • Engineers at TRM are empowered to drive decision-making across product, design, and technical implementation. Rather than waiting days for alignment, engineers are expected to analyze tradeoffs, propose solutions, and move discussions toward clear decisions.

  • TRM has a large group of internal power users who provide fast product feedback. When engineers identify a clear pain point from this group, they are empowered to ship targeted improvements directly to beta users without multiple layers of approval.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

You'll build and improve the tools, applications, and infrastructure that support field team demos, workshops, trials, and internal test environments across the field. Create technical workshop assets and enablement content that support pre-sales and technical selling for individual contributors. Advise on sales opportunities when specialized technical demo support or custom solutions are needed. Improve the presenter experience by reducing manual setup work and making demo workflows easier to use and repeat. Support internal teams that rely on demo or test infrastructure, helping keep those environments available and useful. Troubleshoot urgent demo/workshop environment issues under pressure and communicate status clearly to stakeholders. Ability to deliver production-grade software and automation with attention to reliability, maintainability, and documentation. Ability to work across application development and infrastructure, with comfort navigating provisioning, automation, and service workflows. Familiarity with monitoring/observability tools to shorten investigation time when something breaks. Comfort communicating and collaborating with technical and non-technical stakeholders across Sales, Solutions Architecture, Customer Success, Marketing, UX, and Engineering. Understanding of how to design and iterate on solutions for usability and repeatability, not just technical correctness, with awareness that the end user may be a seller or Solutions Architect. We’re a small, globally distributed group that collaborates asynchronously across regions and adapts quickly to changing needs, with a current focus on scaling automation, enabling more self-service, extending support to partners, and maintaining reliable internal infrastructure. raw.jobDescription:
About Alma

At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well‑balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place - serving merchants and consumers. Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience - without encouraging bad debt. As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered over +25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers. With 400+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!

About the team

The Consumer Tribe builds the Alma app for consumers. To tackle more topics and accelerate the development of the consumer experience, the current Consumer squad is splitting into two dedicated squads: Alma Wallet and Consumer Engagement.

Alma Wallet builds the payment experience of the app. With the Alma card, consumers can pay with Alma anywhere, not only at our partner merchants. In the app, they can manage their payments using Apple Pay, Google Pay or local payment methods. By taking Alma beyond our merchant network, the Alma card is one of the company's key strategic bets.

Consumer Engagement drives consumer activation, engagement and long-term retention by helping people get more value from Alma. The team builds experiences that make it easier for consumers to discover partner merchants, benefit from loyalty and cashback rewards, and manage their account independently.

In 2027, the focus is on turning Alma into a more engaging, everyday consumer experience by strengthening loyalty, increasing repeat usage and making Consumer Engagement a key driver of Alma's long-term growth.

This is a new position created as the consumer app organization splits into two squads to tackle more topics. You will join one of these squads and work closely with its Engineering Manager, Product Manager, Designer and back-end engineers. You will report to Gautier Labarre, Engineering Manager.

This position is a permanent contract (CDI), open to full remote from Metropolitan France.

About the job

  • Build and ship meaningful consumer experiences: Develop and release new features in the Alma app from design to production, working closely with Product, Design and back-end engineers.
  • Make payments simple and secure: Integrate payment SDKs and native mobile capabilities such as Apple Pay, Google Pay, card management, biometrics and secure storage.
  • Raise the quality bar of the app: Keep the application fast, reliable and maintainable through automated testing, monitoring, code reviews and continuous performance improvements.
  • Help the team learn and move forward: Contribute to technical decisions, challenge product and back-end implementation when needed, and improve the team’s architecture, tooling and release processes.

You will work with

  • Mobile: Expo / EAS, Expo Router, React Native, React 19, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Redux Toolkit, react-hook-form, Zod, Reanimated, Unistyles, MMKV, Nitro modules.
  • Tests: Jest, Testing Library, Maestro.
  • Payments: Adyen, Stripe, Checkout.com SDKs.
  • Observability: Datadog, Sentry, OpenTelemetry, OpenFeature.
  • Back-end: Python, FastAPI.
  • Tools: GitHub, Linear, Notion, Figma, Crowdin, Claude.

About you

To succeed in this job

  • You have 3+ years of experience building mobile applications with React Native and TypeScript, with experience releasing apps on both the App Store and Google Play.
  • You have a strong understanding of the React Native ecosystem, including Expo, navigation, state management and data fetching.
  • You care deeply about software quality and have experience with testing, code reviews, monitoring and mobile performance.
  • You are fluent in English and comfortable working in a cross-functional, international environment.

And it will be nice if you also

  • Have worked on payment products, fintech products or other security-sensitive applications.
  • Have experience contributing to a consumer application used at scale.
  • Are comfortable challenging product or back-end implementation when it does not provide the best user or technical outcome.
  • Have experience with web development in addition to mobile development.

Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience.

What's in it for you

If you join, you will be able to grow and impact on:

  • Work on products at the heart of Alma's strategy, including the Alma card, new payment methods in the app and our loyalty programme.
  • Solve real mobile fintech challenges involving payment SDKs, Apple Pay, Google Pay, biometrics and secure storage.
  • Use a modern mobile stack based on Expo 57, React Native’s New Architecture, React 19, TypeScript 7, Reanimated 4 and Nitro modules.

Compensation & benefits

  • Competitive salary based on 12 months
  • Profit-sharing and employee savings plan
  • Health insurance: 100% covered by Alma including family package
  • Disability insurance: 100% covered by Alma
  • Sport: partnerships with Gymlib and Classpass, or €30/month reimbursement for your sports activities
  • Maternity/paternity leave: salary maintained at 100% during leave with no seniority requirement. Return to work at 4/5 schedule paid at 100% for 8 weeks.
  • Sustainable Mobility Package (FMD): €544.80/year (excluding full-remote contracts)
  • Meal vouchers: €10/day, 50% covered by Alma
  • Mental health: free access to MindDay platform
  • Paid time off: 25 days/year (+ additional paid leave granted for employees on executive contracts)
  • Access to our Learning & Development Platform
  • 2 weeks of full remote possible per year in summer

Interview Process

  • Video call with a Talent Acquisition team member to understand your path, motivation and present you the role.
  • Video call with your future manager to deep dive into the role, the team, your profile and answer all your questions.
  • Live testing session with members of the Mobile Engineering team to assess your practical knowledge and approach to mobile development.
  • Coffee Chat with members of the squad you would join, with the panel adapted to Alma Wallet or Consumer Engagement.

Diversity & Inclusion

At Alma, we believe that diversity fuels innovation and makes our community stronger. We are committed to building a workplace where every person feels seen, respected, and empowered to do their best work whatever their gender, background, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion, disability or lived experience. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applicants from all walks of life, and all employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

Location: This role is remote in the United States, Canada, or some countries in South America.

Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients.

At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

  • Foremost a software engineer. You exemplify high code quality and guide others, and have at least 5 years of industry experience as a data engineer or similar role.
    • You are experienced in creating automated testing, applying design patterns, and other engineering best practices.
    • You are an expert in Python and possess fluency in SQL and have developed maintainable data pipelines with each.
  • Hands-on with architecting solutions. You have designed several data pipelines from start to finish. Choosing appropriate technologies, building, testing and rollout.
  • Experience with aychronous systems. You are comfortable identifying and applying APIs, streaming, multithreading, and other asynchronous approaches to the right problems. You understand how to monitor and maintain these systems.
  • Product mindset. You think about the business impact of your work, and can use high-level goals to prioritize work.
  • Communication Extraordinaire. You excel at communicating to both technical and non-technical people, with an ability to explain complex concepts simply.
  • ML/AI–aware. You have working knowledge of how ML/AI applications are deployed and monitored, and you’re motivated to use this awareness to advance data-driven initiatives.

Here's How You Will Make an Impact

  • Collaborate with product managers, data analysts, and machine learning engineers to develop pipelines and ETL tasks in order to facilitate the extraction of insights.
  • Understand product requirements and translate them into actionable project plans that you or your peers execute upon.
  • Establish data architecture processes and practices that can be scheduled, automated, replicated and serve as standards for other teams to leverage.
  • Collaborate with your team's Data Leadership to identify and push forward meaningful projects across the commercial org.

About Us

  • Explore our stack
  • We have over 500 private repositories in Github containing our pipelines, our own internal multi-functional tools, and open-source projects
  • We have worked as a distributed team for a long time; we're currently about 65% distributed
  • Find out more information on the Doximity engineering blog
  • Our company core values
  • Our recruiting process
  • Our product development cycle
  • Our on-boarding & mentorship process

Compensation

The anticipated total compensation for this role is $165,000 - $221,000, depending on factors such as experience, skills, location, and internal equity.

Our total compensation package may include:

  • Base salary
  • Equity (where applicable)
  • Annual bonus or incentive compensation (where applicable)

Specific compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

Benefits

In addition to competitive compensation, Doximity offers a comprehensive benefits package for full time employees. Some of our offerings include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Flexible paid time off and company holidays
  • Paid parental leave
  • Professional development and learning opportunities
  • Wellness and mental health resources
  • Remote work support and home office stipend (where applicable)

Why You'll Love Working Here

At Doximity, you'll join a mission-driven company where your work has a meaningful impact on healthcare. We believe great ideas come from empowered teams, and we're committed to creating an environment where people can do their best work.

  • Make a real impact. Help build products that support over a million healthcare professionals and ultimately improve patient care.
  • Work with exceptional teammates. Collaborate with thoughtful, talented colleagues who value curiosity, humility, and continuous learning.
  • Enjoy flexibility and trust. We support flexible ways of working and empower employees with the autonomy to own their work.
  • Grow your career. Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, and shape your career through mentorship and professional development.
  • Bring your authentic self. We're committed to fostering an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are welcomed, respected, and celebrated.

Our Hiring Process & AI Tools

Doximity may use artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled tools throughout the hiring process to help improve the candidate experience and support our recruiting team. These tools may assist with administrative tasks such as scheduling, general communication, interview coordination, note-taking, or summarizing interview feedback. Human recruiters and hiring managers make all hiring decisions. We are committed to using AI responsibly, transparently, and in accordance with applicable laws.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Doximity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

You’ll collaborate with product, design, and engineering leadership to define the direction of our systems and integrate cutting-edge technologies, including AI-driven services and event-based data pipelines.

If you’re passionate about building resilient systems, mentoring engineers, and driving innovation in how organizations manage and interact with their documents, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.

You will:
Technical Leadership & Architecture

  • Set technical direction for our document content extraction and transformation team, establishing patterns for scalable, secure, and performant systems on AWS.
  • Lead architectural decisions that use OCR technologies such as Tesseract and Apryse OCR.
  • Drive initiatives that improve scalability, performance, and reliability of the product while considering and implementing changes that control costs without impacting customer satisfaction.
  • Guide the evolution of our content extraction and transformation technology stack as the business and customer needs mature and scale.
  • Make critical technical decisions that balance user experience, performance, security, and maintainability.

Product Design and Build

  • Design and implement event-driven architectures using AWS services, Kafka, and modern data pipelines.
  • Build production-grade applications across C#/.Net, AWS services, and document extraction/transformation technologies.
  • Design and implement scalable APIs (REST, GraphQL) that power our front-end and enable third-party integrations.
  • Integrate AI-driven services and emerging technologies to enable greater backend efficiencies and increase customer productivity.
  • Build the product to enable seamless, scalable, and flexible semantic search capabilities.
  • Ensure security, performance, and compliance considerations are applied across all implementations.

Problem Solving & Ownership

  • Solve complex technical challenges from real-time customer experiences and issues to event-driven document processing at scale.
  • Take full ownership of initiatives from concept through production and ongoing evolution.
  • Make sound architectural decisions by weighing trade-offs with reasoning that stands up over time.
  • Proactively identify and address technical debt before it impacts the team.

Build and Optimize Systems

  • Write high-quality, well-tested code across the full stack with emphasis on maintainability.
  • Design resilient systems that maintain uptime and performance as we scale globally.
  • Implement observability through logging, metrics, and telemetry to proactively triage issues.
  • Monitor and optimize performance at scale, identifying bottlenecks and implementing solutions.
  • Create comprehensive technical documentation including architectural diagrams and design decisions.

Collaboration & Mentorship

  • Partner closely with product management to translate requirements into technical solutions.
  • Mentor engineers across experience levels, elevating technical skills and best practices.
  • Collaborate with Platform Services, Ops, and other teams on integration points and shared infrastructure.
  • Build consensus on technical approaches while having authority to make final decisions when needed.
  • Lead knowledge-sharing initiatives through code reviews, design discussions, and documentation.

Continuous Learning & Innovation

  • Stay at the forefront of content extraction and transformation technologies and industry trends, cloud-native architectures, and AI-powered tools.
  • Research and prove out new technologies through POCs that align with product strategy.
  • Contribute ideas that directly improve engineering velocity and quality.

What You’ll Need to Be Successful

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field—or equivalent experience.
  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience delivering production-grade applications at scale on cloud platforms.
  • 5+ years in technical leadership and development roles using OCR technologies.
  • Proven track record of building scalable applications still in production.
  • Required Technical Knowledge
  • Expert proficiency in C#/.NET.
  • Expert proficiency with OCR technologies such as Tesseract or Apryse
  • Expert proficiency building event-driven, microservice-based products
  • Expert proficiency developing on cloud platforms, preferably AWS
  • Expert proficiency with Kafka or similar event streaming platforms
  • Expert proficiency in observability, including logging, metrics, tracing, telemetry, preferably with DataDog

What Will Make You Stand Out

  • Deep experience building with OCR & Text Extraction technologies.
  • Deep experience building document management or enterprise content management
  • Deep knowledge of event-driven architectures.
  • You know what it means and takes to ingest millions of documents an hour into a SaaS based document management platform
  • Track record of developing high-performance content extraction and transformation products at scale.
  • Legal industry expertise or experience with B2B SaaS in regulated industries.
  • Experience integrating AI services and emerging technologies into production systems.

What You’ll Love About NetDocuments

  • The People!
  • 90% healthcare premiums company covered
  • HSA company contribution
  • 401K match at 4% with immediate vesting
  • Flexible PTO (typically 3 to 4 weeks a year)
  • 10 paid holidays
  • Monthly contributions for life activities & wellness
  • Access to LinkedIn Learning with monthly dedicated time to explore
  • Connection, access, and mentorship from exceptional leaders
  • Growing company with opportunities for advancement
  • Authenticity and accountability from leadership

Compensation Transparency

The compensation range for this position is $170,000 – $190,000.
The posted cash compensation includes on-target earnings. Some roles may qualify for overtime pay. Individual compensation packages are determined based on factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location.

A little about us…Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations. Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation!

More about our team and company:

  • Our careers page: https://www.fleetio.com/careers

Description

Fleetio is looking for a product-minded and collaborative Software Engineer to join our Growth Engineering team. Growth Engineering is focused on helping customers realize value from Fleetio as quickly as possible by building thoughtful onboarding experiences, improving product adoption, and experimenting with features that drive long-term engagement.

In this role, you'll build features across the product that make it easier for users to discover value, adopt new workflows, and successfully manage their fleets. You'll work closely with Product Managers, Designers, Data Operations, and fellow engineers to turn insights into product improvements and measurable customer outcomes.

This is an opportunity to work on a team that values experimentation, collaboration, and continuous learning while delivering high-quality software that directly impacts customer growth and retention.

This is a remote opportunity open to candidates in the United States, Canada, or Mexico.

More About Engineering

  • Watch our culture videos: https://fleet.io/culture

  • Fleetio Go overview video: https://www.fleetio.com/go

  • API docs: developer.fleetio.com
  • Test drive Fleetio to get an even better feel for what we're building: https://www.fleetio.com/register

Who You Are

Our ideal candidate enjoys solving business problems through thoughtful product development and collaborative engineering. You care about building intuitive user experiences, writing clean and maintainable code, and using data to help inform product decisions.

You are curious, detail-oriented, and eager to learn through experimentation. You enjoy working with cross-functional teammates, are comfortable receiving and giving feedback, and thrive in an environment where you can make meaningful contributions while continuing to grow as an engineer.

This role is part of the Engineering department and reports to the Engineering Manager.

Your Impact

  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, Data Operations, and other Engineers to deliver high-quality product experiences.

  • Help build experiments that validate product ideas and measure customer impact.
  • Contribute to technical discussions and collaborate on solutions that balance customer value with technical excellence.
  • Deliver well-tested, maintainable, and performant code.
  • Prototype solutions and iterate quickly based on customer feedback and product insights.
  • Participate in code reviews, share knowledge with teammates, and contribute to a collaborative engineering culture.

Your Experience

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Experience building modern web applications using React and TypeScript.
  • Exposure to A/B testing, experimentation frameworks, or feature flagging.
  • Familiarity with product analytics or user behavior tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, Heap, or similar platforms.
  • Experience building full-stack web applications and customer-facing features.
  • Understanding of object-oriented programming principles and relational databases such as PostgreSQL.

  • Experience with unit testing frameworks.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Be sure to mention "coffee" in your application so we know you actually read this.

Considered a Plus

  • 1+ years of experience with Ruby on Rails.
  • Experience using customer data to inform product decisions.
  • Experience improving onboarding, activation, or engagement experiences.
  • Project experience with Tailwind CSS.

  • Multiple health/dental coverage options (100% coverage for employee, 50% for family)
  • Vision insurance
  • Incentive stock options
  • 401(k) match of 4%
  • PTO - 4 weeks (increases at year two!)

The role sits at the intersection of Commercial, Marketing, Finance, Data Analytics & Product, ensuring pricing decisions balance customer value, competitive positioning, profitability, and growth objectives. Demonstrated experience building pricing frameworks and governance models. Strong background in market research and willingness-to-pay methodologies. Experience designing pricing bundles, packaging strategies, and commercial offers. Experience driving pricing transformations in complex organizations. Preferred Experience Payments, fintech, SaaS, software, technology, telecommunications, financial services, or marketplace experience. Du sorgst für die marktgerechte Weiterentwicklung der Abrechnungslösung. Das bringst du mit Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-SaaS-Plattformen, mit agilen Entwicklungsmethoden und in der Skalierung. Technische Konzepte verstehst du so gut, dass du mit der Entwicklung auf Augenhöhe diskutieren kannst. Du bringst Erfahrung in Abrechnungs- und Inkassoprozessen mit, idealerweise in einem ZEV- (vZEV, LEG) Umfeld. Du kennst die Stromtarifmodelle im europäischen Raum und die regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen der Schweiz (Energiewirtschaft).
